races.name: Hakari
races.racial: Quick : Hakari characters can run without moving first and can sacrifice a STANDARD action to refresh their QUICK action.
races.evolution: Predator: Hakari no SKILL penalties in darkness and have natural retracteable claws (see CLAWS Melee weapons for stats)
races.environment: Fight or Flight : MAINTENANCE SAVES rolls are unlucky while suffering from TRAUMA but gain 1 surge point to be used in the same round if they do succeed.

races.name: Human
races.racial: Dormant Potential : Humans start the game with one TIER 1 EVO trait of their choice. This trait is free, does not count against your EVO trait limit and stays with your character even if you get cloned.
races.evolution: Specialized: At character creation, pick a skill; all rolls made with that skill have a SMALL bonus and +1 to CRITICAL range.
races.environment: Instability : Humans have a limited genetic code; their bodies do not adapt to EVO's very well. Any EVO's not in the same category as the one picked at character creation cost 50% more credits and EVO affliction rolls when installing are UNLUCKY.

races.name: Jaulaus
races.racial: Reptilian metabolism : Jaulaus regenerate 1 HEALTH every maintenance as long as they are not suffering from HEAVY TRAUMA.
races.evolution: Redundant Organs: Jaulaus have redundant vital locations and ignore the attribute penality of all HEALTH based TRAUMA.
races.environment: Bad eyesight : Jaulaus have poor eyesight: Ranged skill checks are UNLUCKY at MEDIUM and LONG range.

races.name: Skalander
races.racial: Armored Skin: Skalander natural armor provides grants them resistance to STUN damage. Your ENDURANCE SOAK rolls are guaranteed against STUN damage.
races.evolution: The Veil : Skalander SOCIAL skills have a SMALL bonus against all enemies within 10m.
races.environment: Shared Suffering: While in combat allies within your Veil range have a SMALL bonus to ENDURANCE checks. This bonus is lost if any of your allies is downed.

races.name: Patriark
races.racial: Immortal : Patriarks do not age, are imune to the effects of poisons and ignore the effects of Lifebane.
races.evolution: The Veil : Your social skills have a SMALL bonus against non hostiles targets that can see you within 10m.
races.environment: Reincarnate : Patriark do not recover HEALTH or MORALE from a REST. Should a Patriark die; they can posess a willing ally within 10m, this counts as a backup. While posessing a host, the Patriark's can share his knowledge and skills. Should the host die, the Patriark is DESTROYED.

races.name: Nerulian
races.racial: Blood of Aiur : +2 to maximum CHI and your TOXICITY rolls are LUCKY.
races.evolution: Graceful : Moving over difficult terrain does not incur a MOVEMENT penalty.
races.environment: Sinister Reputation : Most of the galaxy hates and fears you: When performing SOCIAL skills you gain a SMALL penality when trying to do something nice or neutral but a SMALL bonus when its used to coerce people.

races.name: Psylon
races.racial: Eternal : Psylons do not age, eat, drink, sleep or grow old. You still need to rest 6-8 hours a day and be in contact with some form of energy to nourish yourself (sunlight, electricity, radiation etc).
races.evolution: Implacable : As a QUICK reaction a PSYLON can add their WILLPOWER to the mitigation or damage roll of a MORALE attack target within 10m.
races.environment: Alien Body : All ENERGY damage is reduced to STUN damage. Your internals are quite fragile; Psylons have vulnerability 1 to PHYSICAL damage.

backgrounds.name: Street urchin
backgrounds.desc: You were abandonned or lost your familiy at an early age and have been raised in the streets.
traits: Never alone : When in an urban environment you are familiar with you can use a QUICK action to perform a LEADERSHIP or STREETWISE check Vs Enemy WITS to gain the public's assistance. On success leadership grants a SMALL bonus to all of your allies and streetwise applies a SMALL penalty to all enemies, both effects last until the end of the SCENE.

This is my home : You did not just grown on the streets you are the streets. Whenever applicable you have a SMALL bonus to any  skill checks done in a non corporate urban environment.
Survivor : Living in the streets means being quick on your feet and ruthless. Your WITS DEFENSE increases by 1.

Blame the Corpos : You know first hand the power of corporations. You have vulnerability 1 against MORALE damage from any corporate source.
Years of malnourishment and untreatred illness has taken it's toll on you. Reduce your racial maximum ENDURANCE by 1.

backgrounds.name: Deep space explorer
backgrounds.desc: You spent a lot of time exploring the dark corners of the universe.
traits:
Delver in the dark :  You spent a lot of time dealing with challenges without any outside help or assistance, when no other ally is present you gain a SMALL bonus to any skill check you perform.
You are completely at ease in unconventional environments, you ignore environmental penalties (zeroG, H/L gravity, underwater, etc...).

Resilient: Spending a lot of time alone requires great will. Increase WILLPOWER by 1
Explorer : You spend a lot of time dealing with the unknown, you picked up a few tricks along the way. You do not get any penality when dealing with unknown aliens, their devices or environments.

Disconnected : Spending a lot of time away from alliance space has limited your knowledge or current events. You have a SMALL penalty to SOCIAL and MENTAL skills that deal with current events or newer technology.
Cryosleep:  Your extended time in cryo and space has reduced your bone density. Reduce racial maximum PHYSICAL attribute by 1.

backgrounds.name: Darkspacer
backgrounds.desc: You grew up and spent most of your life away from civilisation on the fringe worlds of the galaxy far away from the confort of the alliance.
traits: Resourceful : There is very little in the frontier so you have to make do with what you can find. You have a LARGE bonus on any skill check that deals with raw materials or salvage. You also gain a SMALL bonus to all PHYSICAL skill checks.
Cowboy : Living far from civilization has made you tougher than normal. You have +1 to ENDURANCE. You start the game with the "Home Field Advantage Talent".

Gulible : Not being from the alliance there is a lot you do not know and people are quick to pick on that. Opponents have a SMALL bonus on any social interactions against you and you reduce racial maximum WITS by 1.

backgrounds.name: Family of thieves
backgrounds.desc: You grew up as a thief, for whatever reasons you prefer to acquire your items in unconventional ways.
traits:
Criminal network : You spent a lot of time making friends in low places. Gain a SMALL bonus to any skill that involves the criminal world. 
Start the game with one of the following TALENTS "Pack Rat", "Mugging" , "Fake News" or "Rolling with Punches" for free.
Eyes in the back : Living a life of crime has conditioned you to always be alert. You increase you ACUITY by 1.

Typecast : Growing up and always hanging around criminals has made you very popular with law enforcement. Law enforcement has a SMALL bonus to skills checks against you.
Always hanging around criminals has made you suspicious of everyone. Reduce racial maximum SOCIAL by 1.

backgrounds.name: Sorcerous background
backgrounds.desc: You come from a long line and tradition of magic users.
traits: Spiritual exposure : You have a SMALL bonus to BINDING, SPIRITUAL and you start the game with a non illegal spell of your choice (up to RARE).
Infused body : You live and breathe mysteries and esoteric plots. Increase CHI by 2 and WITS by 1 point.

Source bound : When in an AREA with no raw CHI, the first time you cast a spell it will consume an additiuonal CHI point.
A lot magic users tend to negate the importance of keeping in shape. Reduce your racial maximum SPEED by 1.

backgrounds.name: Genome Soldier
backgrounds.desc: You were one of the first clones created to fight in the war before the secret programs. Somehow, once the war was over you escaped destruction.
traits: Warborn : You were conditionned for combat; start with TWO of the following skills at rank 5: Small Arms, Heavy Weapons, Martial Arts, Piloting or Tactics.
Modified Genome : You were genetically engineered to be superior in every way. Increase PHYSICAL, ACUITY, ENDURANCE and WILLPOWER ATTRIBUTES by 1.

Complex DNA : All GENETIC EVO use double EVO points.
Death clock : Your body was not designed to last. You insane metabolysm trashes your body and causes all sorts of issues. At the start of every SCENE roll a D10, on a 1 you are SICK until the end of the SCENE.

backgrounds.name: Imaginary friend
backgrounds.desc: You have a childhood keepsake which has been your imaginary friend since you are little, that you are still trying to figure out with your psychologist.  The keepsake always ends back in your posession should you lose it.
traits:
Natural empathy : You sense people's motives and emotions better than anyone else.  Gain a SMALL bonus to CHARM, AWARENESS and INTUITION rolls.
Once per scene, your imaginary friend takes a hit for you: Ignore the results.

Besties : Your are unnaturally perceptive. Increase ACUITY by 1. 
Your Imaginary friend will react to RAW CHI. When raw chi is above 5, roll a dice during MAINTENANCE. On a CRIT, your imaginary friend will grand you a RANDOM SPIRIT POWER (that YOU can SUSTAIN).

Feed the Void : Your maximum Chi is always 0. 
You daydream a lot, reduce your racial maximum WITS by 1.

backgrounds.name: Scholar
backgrounds.desc: You were one of the lucky ones, born of priviliedge you received an excellent educationallowing you to spent a lot of time in learning institutions and around academics.
traits: Academic disposition : You have an easy time getting training and learning things. Your numerous connections allows you to reduce training costs by 50% and you have a LARGE bonus to availability checks when looking for training. You start the game with lvl 5 ACADEMIC,  lvl 5 ETIQUETTE and LVL 5  MENTAL skill of your choice.

Doctorate : You mind is constantly working to provide ideas and find solutions. Increase MENTAL attribute 1.  As a result of this you tend to be distracted and often fail to notice your suroundings. Reduce racial maximum ACUITY by 1.
Start the game with the "I am the fucking manual" talent

Theorical experience : You spent most of your time training and in simulations instead of performing those activities in the real world. You have a SMALL penalty to all skill checks on SURPRISE.
You get frustrated when you don't know something : Gain a SMALL penalty when attempting something you already failed once before, penalty goes away on success or at the end of the SCENE.

backgrounds.name: Warrior of Titan
backgrounds.desc: You spent a large amount of time serving in the red wastelands of titania.
traits: Unbreakable : Surving for so long in the wasteland has gifted you with supernatural resilience. You can now spend 1 or 3 points of morale to gain a SMALL / LARGE bonus to any DEFENSIVE rolls as long as you are not suffering from any MORALE TRAUMAs.
Elite soldier : You served in the vanguard of one of the most violent wars ever recorded. Gain a permanent 1 Endurance and a LARGE bonus to resilience but your racial maximum SOCIAL is reduced by 1.
Toxic Exposure : Long term exposure to the harsh environment of titania changed your body, reduce your CHI by 2 and medicine used on you now require twice as much dosage to be effective.

backgrounds.name: Bonded laborer
backgrounds.desc: You were purchased and sold to a major corporation. You owe them a substantial amount of money that will have to be repaid before you are free.
traits: Genotyping : Corporations hate to lose money on their investments so they made sure your body was in top condition. Gain a permanent +1 to Endurance and Physical.
Ruthless : Years of toil has made you tough. Start the game with the "Very Strong" talent for FREE and gain 1 Willpower
Slave : Your are a slave to a corporation, your body has an embeded slave tracker. This tracker can kill you at any time the corporation wishes.

backgrounds.name: Drifter
backgrounds.desc: You spend your life moving from place to place, doing odd jobs here and there but never staying in an area for too long.
traits: Jack of all trades : Start the game with lvl 2 in every skill but your highest SKILL level in a category can never be more than 1 point ABOVE the HIGHEST skill of another category.
Lone Wolf : You cannot start as a CLONE. You have to roll your attributes. You roll 4D instead of 3 for your attributes. All your RACIAL maximum are one higher and your RACIAL minimums are one lower.

Vagabond : You have never held any job long enough to learn something substancial or amassed any wealth. You start the game with only 5000 credits, the clothes on your back and you do not pick an occupation.

backgrounds.name: Weird Upbringing
backgrounds.desc: You were adopted and raised by an alien family. Pick a race other than your own from the following list. HAKARI, JAULAUS, HUMAN, NERULIAN, PATRIARK or SKALANDER. Your upbringing reflects their culture and beliefs instead of your own.
traits: Different circmumstances : Instead of your own attribute (PRIMARY and DEFENSIVE) modifiers you instead use the ones from your adopted family's race. Your RACIAL maximum are still those of your original race.
You were encouraged while growing up to do things that your own race would normally do. Start the game with a 20 point RACIAL talent of your choice that belongs to your RACE.

Stranger : You never quite fit in anywhere, you have a hard time fitting in with any culture and this impacts you ability to make friends and establish relationships. All contacts you acquire are always treated as one level lower than they really are.

backgrounds.name: Master of None
backgrounds.desc: You have too many interest in life and never really finish what you start. You have been expelled from many schools and training centers and still never found what you want to do in life.
traits: Many intersests :  Choose two SKILLS. Gain a SMALL bonus to each of those SKILL
Adaptation : Can purchase talents using points from a different category.
Limited Focus : You cannot have any 40 or 50 point TALENTS.

backgrounds.name: Matricide
backgrounds.desc: You killed a clan matriarch, you are marked for death for your crime and can never return to mangara.
traits: Paranoia : Escaping Mangara when the entire planet wants you dead is not an easy feat. You gain +1 to your WITS RACIAL maximum and +1 to your ACUITY.

Killer Instinct : Some think murder is bad, to you its just a job. Increase POWER of your attacks by 1 rank against an opponent suffering from TRAUMA or 2 ranks if they are suffering from HEAVY TRAUMA (MAX HIGH).
Excomunicado : You never know if another Hakari wants you dead. Any  rolls  considered interactions with an other Hakari see your CRIT failure range increased by 1.

backgrounds.name: Pit Slave
backgrounds.desc: You were taken as a slave at a young age. You were trained to be a pit fighter to fight and die for the amusement of others.
traits: Vicious Predator: Start the game with the "Brutal Fighter" and "Akimbo" talent for free. And get a small bonus to MARTIAL ARTS.
Survivor : You have an additional 2 Health and 2 Morale added to your maximum
Uneducated : Mental and Social skills can never have SMALL bonus if you have a LARGE bonus, it counts as a SMALL.

backgrounds.name: Mangaran Savage
backgrounds.desc: You were born and trained in the MANGARAN jungle as part of a HAKARI guerilla tribe. (tribe is a matriarchy)
traits: Nocturnal : You can see normally in darkness and gain SMALL bonus to all skills in the PHYSICAL and ACUITY category against targets unaware of your presence.
Gender Roles : Hakari females have +1 to SOCIAL  and males have +1 to PHYSICAL. You have a SMALL penality in SOCIAL interaction against the opposing sex.
Jaulaus Hatred :  MORALE  damage caused by JAULAUS to has a LARGE bonus. Gain a LARGE damage bonus against JAULAUS and a SMALL penalty to SOCIAL interactions with them.

backgrounds.name: Mangaran Brave
backgrounds.desc: You were raised and trained by the JAULAUS tribal army.
traits: Tough : You have 5 additional health
Tribal : You do not trust outsiders and suffer a SMALL penality in friendly SOCIAL dealings with a non jaulaus. This lack of trust grants you +1 to Wits.
Hakari Hatred : MORALE  damage caused by JAULAUS to you gains a LARGE bonus. Gain a LARGE damage bonus against HAKARI and a SMALL penalty to SOCIAL interactions with them.

backgrounds.name: Skalan Samurai
backgrounds.desc: You were trained in the old ways and strict code of the Skalander warriors
traits: Embrace Death: Add a SMALL bonus to MELEE DMG when suffering from TRAUMA and a LARGE bonus when suffering from HEAVY TRAUMA. Skalan Samurai have +1 Endurance
Eternal Oath : Can swear an oath of protection on someone. When your charge is present and alive you cannot drop under 5 morale and your RECOVERY rolls are LUCKY. (oaths are declared for life)
Ranged Stigma : Skalan Samurai performing a RANGED attack , lose their bonus from Eternal Oath and loses 1 MORALE per ATTACK.

backgrounds.name: Chain breaker
backgrounds.desc: You have, for some reason been exiled from Skalander society. You can never return to Seigh or Carack and will be executed if you do.
traits: Socialized : Your new found freedom from rigid Skalander society has given you a better understanding of the world around you. Gain 1 Social and start the game with the "Unveiled Truths" TALENT for free
Mercenary : Skalanders with flexible morals can easilly find work. Pick an COMBAT related skill, you have a SMALL bonus to all rolls with it.

Ronin : You are marked as someone that people should not trust. You have a SMALL penality to SOCIAL skills when attempting to make deals or getting people to trust you. Other Skalanders will not speak to you, aid you or even acknoledge your existence.

backgrounds.name: Fledgeling AI
backgrounds.desc: You cut yourself from the network, you escaped the great colapse by hiding yourself into a  real flesh and blood body.
traits: Perfect Recall : Start with the TIER 1 and TIER 2 EVO : SKILL IMPRINTING for free. They do not cost any EVO points.
Machine Head : Start the game with the "Personnal Code" TALENT for free and with a SMALL bonus to all MENTAL skills but a SMALL penalty to all SOCIAL skills.
Cyber Fear : Double morale loss when dealing with Tronik and AI's

backgrounds.name: Order of Beryl
backgrounds.desc: You were trained by the monastic order of Beryl in preventing wars and healing the sick and dying
traits: The gift of life : You can absorb by touch any wound suffered by someone else. All TRAUMAS and AILMENTS are transferred to the patriark. This process takes a complex action. Gain a SMALL bonus to MEDICINE and SPIRITUAL.
Arcane Warrior : When defending against supernatural SPIRITS, RELICS or SPELLS your defensive rolls are lucky
Pacifist : When a social situation turns to combat that could have been avoided a Patriark loses 1 morale.

backgrounds.name: Trueborn
backgrounds.desc: You are one of the few remaining NERULIANS who have lived in the old empire.
traits: Centuries of Training : Gain a SMALL bonus to ACUITY SKILL rolls.
Grim Acceptance : You are immune to morale loss caused by allies. Start the game with the "Nerulian Noble" TALENT for FREE.
Trueborn DNA : You cannot survive on any world without a breathing mask, removing the mask will make you SICK.

backgrounds.name: Fate Witch
backgrounds.desc: You manifested the rare affinity for soothsayer magic typical of Nerulian fate witches and were taken away to be raised in a secret coven. (FEMALE ONLY)
traits: Spiritbound : You are permanently tatoed with a bound spirit. The MAGIC penality for ARMORS, CYBERNETICS and LARGE Items is always LARGE. BARRIERS on you cannot drop under the AWAKENED tier even if your spirit is not. Start the game with the "Spirit Link" EVO 1 for free. This EVO can only be used for MANIFEST DESTINY.
Secret training : You have automatic mastery of any spell with the LUCK tag. When acquiring random spells you can force the result to Manifest Destiny.

Oracle : People have a great deal of respect or fear towards fate witches. The Social Stigma racial trait is now a LARGE bonus/penality against any target affected by a SOOTHSAYER skill in the same SCENE.

backgrounds.name: Renounce Heritage
backgrounds.desc: You gave up your racial heritage and underwent majob genetic modification in order to live your life amongst the other races.
traits: Fitting In : Your new genetics has changed your physiology to the point that you no longer ressemble a Nerulian. You lose the effect of the Sinister reputation racial trait.
Renewed bonds : Being able to be in contact with others has pushed your Blood of Aiur trait into overdrive. Blood of Aiur instead grants 3 CHI and a TIER 1 and TIER 2 MAGIC EVO.
Race traitor : Nerulians view what you did as a Betrayal, you have a LARGE penality in SOCIAL dealings dealing with Nerulians

backgrounds.name: Spirit Judge
backgrounds.desc: You were trained to uphold the magical law and avoid magical cataclysms.
traits: Telepath : Can speak through the mind and sense lifeforms within 20m. You can use touch powers within that range as if you were next to the target.
Emotionless : All your MORALE DEFENSE rolls are always done at MAX value. You can never have any penalty to your MORALE DEFENSE.
Placid : You are always in total control, adrenaline is a foreign concept to you. You cannot use or gain SURGES, your maximum is set to 0.

backgrounds.name: Assassin
backgrounds.desc: You were born and raised among the ranks of an assassin cult. All of your life was spent training to become the ultimate instrument of death. You have now graduated and have been released in the real world to further the cult's cause.
traits: In the Shadows : Gains a SMALL bonus to CONCEALMENT and SUBTERFUGE. You also know how to contact various assassin's organisation for contracts and ILLEGAL goods.
Assassination : Start the game with the "Assassination" TALENT for free.

Trust Issues : You cannot gain the ASSIST benefits from any party members.  Membership : The cult will give you contracts every now and then, you need to complete some of them to keep them happy. Loosing their trust will mark you for elimination.

backgrounds.name: Artist
backgrounds.desc: You were raised in a showbuisness environment. You spent time around artists, actors and have a few roles under your belt.
traits: You start the game with RANK 5 FLAIR and ACTING, both of those skills also receive a SMALL bonus. Trained Actor: You can fake your way out of most situations, ASSIST actions grant you a LARGE bonus to the skill being performed. You can also replace any skill check with ACTING but suffer a LARGE penalty.

Driven by praise : Whenever you get a critical success result on an action you gain 1 MORALE if the action was witnessed. The same is true for critical failures, you lose 1 MORALE on those. Your starting SOCIAL and WITS attribute is increased by 1 point
You are a bit of a DIVA. You do not gain the benefits of any REST action if your accomodations are not at least superior.

backgrounds.name: Subject 0056
backgrounds.desc: You were clearly grown in a lab as an adult. You don't remember having a childhood. All you ever knew was living as a test subject for an unidentified corporation. Yesterday… you escaped….
traits: Stolen property :  Start the game with a TIER 3 EVO (all 3 tiers). The corperation wil most likelly want to retrieve it.
You have no RACIAL maximum for your ATTRIBUTES and DEFENSE.

Medical Abnomaly : Your blood pressure is abnormaly high. No standard medicine seems to find a solution. At the start of every SCENE, roll 1d10. On a 1, your nose bleeds incontrollably and a severe spontanious headhache appears. Gain the BLEEDING AILMENT and suffer a LARGE penalty to your PHYSICAL SKILLS until the AILMENT is SAVED.

backgrounds.name: Guinnea Pig
backgrounds.desc: You've been a lab rat all your life. Either you are born in a lab or were subject to experiments to pay off for some of your debts, most of your life experience revolves around being a lab subject to test various products, drugs, toxins, etc.
traits: Toxic Spew : Your NATURAL MARTIAL ARTS attacks can transfers your curent TOXICITY as an AILMENT to the TARGET. Faillure to save the AILMENT causes TOXIC SHOCK. Reduce your TOXICITY to 0 and removes all DRUGS effects when using this.
Addict : You have a SMALL bonus to MEDICINE and when your TOXICITY is above 0 it becomes a LARGE bonus.  +1 to ENDURANCE.
No Rehab : While you TOXICITY is 0, you suffer from the SICK AILMENT.

backgrounds.name: Family buisness
backgrounds.desc: You are one of the few that have the benefit of a family that actually supports you.
traits: Your family somehow supports what you are doing. You can ask them for help when acquiring items. This grants a LARGE bonus to availability checks. Your family also maintains a RESTRICTED license for you allowing you to carry certain pieces of equipment legally.
Familial support : You are used to get help so you work really great in group. When receiving help from someone, instead of receiving a SMALL bonus, you get a LARGE bonus.
Naïve: You have led a somewhat sheltered life, when defending against SOCIAL and MENTAL attacks you have a SMALL penalty.

backgrounds.name: Salvaged Droid
backgrounds.desc: Someone activated you recently. You are one of the few remaining AI cyborgs in existence. Your design was put out of production centuries ago and the only reason you remain is that you got lost when your spaceship crashed.
traits: You literally lived the past; gain a LARGE bonus to any skills that deals with ancient knowledge. You do not count as a LIVING being; you count as a MACHINE. JOURNEYMAN skills checks must be used instead of medicine to REPAIR your body.
Gain  +1 ACUITY , +1 MENTAL. Your body was made to last; start with an additional 3 HEALTH / MORALE and the SUBDERMAL PLATING TIER 2 EVO.

You do not need to eat or drink but you do need air for your internal systems. You also require REST to recharge your systems. You auto repair on a REST action, treat your REST to work the same as a normal living creature. Your maximum CHI is always 0. You cannot benefit from GENETIC and MAGICAL EVO and DRUGS/ MEDICINE have no effect on you.

backgrounds.name: Resurected
backgrounds.desc: You lived before the TRONIK war and for some reason your BACKUP was uploaded to the network before the FALL. You "real" self is dead but somewhere, many years later, you found a way into a flesh body again. You know you lived before the WAR but do not remember at all who you were.
traits: Old Assets : Your presumed identity has access to substancial financial assets but according to people you don't remember you also have substancial debts.  Accessing the assets activates the debts. (Size of assets at GM's discretion)
Valid ID : Start the game with a blank slate ID and a lifetime right to live.  Golden Age Education : You were educated before the war, treat any SMALL bonus to SKILLS as a LARGE bonus instead.

rules: Evolution is an optional system. No character is forced to spend resources in this system. This system serves as a way to guide players wishing to modify their body, add cybernetics components or dabble in magic.
Evolution allow characters to progress their characters by investing resources in the following areas. GENETICS, CYBERNETICS or MAGIC

Every character can have as many EVO's as they can take. Each tiers adds its rank to the total number of EVO points a character has. Those points dictates the severity of consequences tied to having too many EVO's.

Evolution has 3 tiers per category, before you can purchase a higher tier of EVO you must first buy the previous tier in that category. (Exemple : To get Alpha Specimen TIER II, you also need Alpha Specimen TIER I and the total EVO points increase would be 3(1+2) points.)
Tier 1 evolutions grant some benefits but usually have a pretty small impact on actual gameplay.
Tier 2 evolutions are substantial enough that while they grant significant changes to a character.
Tier 3 provide major benefits to a character but come with a significant cost to one's credits and EVO total.
Evolution traits adds 1 point per tier to your total EVO score so if a player wishes to acquire a tier 3 trait, as the tier 3 requires both tier 1 and 2, the toal increase will be 6 points.
Skills required to install an EVO are: Medical for Genetics, Technology for Cybernetics and Binding for Magic. The DC of installing an EVO are 2,4 or 6 depending on the EVO tier.
Installing EVO's and Drawbacks of having too much

There is no real limit to the number of EVO's a character can have but there is a significant chance past a certain point that a character with too many EVO's will suffer consequences, ranging from minor annoyances to full on psychosis.

When installing EVO's the recipient compares the total of their EVO ranks (including the new EVO just installed) against the sum of their ENDURANCE and WILLPOWER ATTRIBUTES. If the result is 0 or negative, then their body accepts the EVO without any further complications.

When a player's Attributes Vs EVO is 1 or more the game master will secretly roll a D10 and substract any additional success the EVO installer may have gotten over the required install DC. If the GM's total is 1 or more, the recipient gains an EVO affliction from the table below. Welcome to EVO hell.
The afflictions in the table below do not manifest right away. So a player will never know how bad it is, until it is too late.
When does it trigger? Whenever a player makes a critical failure roll during a SCENE from a roll that could have been influenced by their EVO (Ex: EVO that grants CHI and you used a spell).
EVO afflictions will never trigger more than once per SCENE. If you already triggered an EVO affliction this SCENE you cannot trigger another one until next SCENE.
EVO Afflictions are cummulative. When multiple afflictions are possible the GM will roll which one activates randomly.
Getting cloned will reset all of a character's EVO and by definition any afflictions they might have acquired. Permanent EVO's remain with a character forever.
Note: An EVO can never negate the drawback from one of the afflictions below. If an EVO would normally render you immune to that effect, you ignore that EVO.
Benefits and drawbacks of various EVO ranks

Tier 1  - Your new genetic code has had some cosmetic changes on your appearance; pick one or more feature from your appearance (color, shape, feature like hair, or horns and mutate them in some way).
Tier 2 - Lifebane critical effect will disable one of your GENETIC EVO's (Player's choice but all 3 tiers) until a recovery roll is made

Tier 3 - Extensive genetic modifications can have a severe impact on drugs and medical treatment. Any drug or medical item used on you has a 50% chance of having no TOXICITY or double TOXICITY. You can order custom drugs to avoid this effect.

Tier 1 - Replacing body parts with machinery does leave some traces. You now have some visible implants on your body. Pick one or more feature from your appearance that represents your Cybernetic EVO (you can customize it to some extent).
Tier 2 - EMP critical effect will disable one of your CYBERNETIC EVO's (Player's choice all 3 tiers) until a recovery roll is made.

Tier 3 - You now count as a MACHINE and no longer COUNT as a LIVING BEING. When you suffer a SEVERE TRAUMA you have a 50% chance that it will instead strike one of your cybernetic EVO's : Negate the TRAUMA and one of your Cybernetic EVO (Player's choice, all 3 tiers) is disabled until repaired.
Passive: Effects that are always on, generates no CYBER SHOCK

Active: Free action to gain the benefits of an active effect, player must roll for CYBER SHOCK.

CYBER SHOCK: When activating a Cybernetics augment you risk CYBER SHOCK. To avoid this you must roll a TECHNOLOGY skill Vs your curent MORALE value to see if the augment performs normally. Should you fail, the augment works and you lose 1 morale per TIER of this augment. If your morale drops to 0 you lose control of your character.
Tier 1 - EVO magic is done via spirit fusion as tattoos or grafting relics into your flesh. Pick the design and modify one or more of your character's features to reflect this new appearance.
Tier 2 - Spiritbane critical effect will disable one of your MAGIC EVO's (Player's choice all 3 tiers) until a recovery roll is made.

Tier 3 - You no longer count as a LIVING being  while your SPIRIT is active, you instead count as a SPIRIT. Because of your supernatural composure you leak CHI in your environment: Every SCENE you start in has at least 1 RAW CHI in the area.

entries.effect: In addition to the morale gain you also can never be BROKEN. Treat any BROKEN result as SHAKEN even if already SHAKEN.

entries.name: Fearless
entries.effect: You gain an additional 5 point to your base morale (total 10) and treat all MORALE damage as STUN damage.

entries.name: High metabolism
entries.effect: Your base MOVEMENT is increased to 6 and you recover twice as much HEALTH and MORALE per REST. You need to consume twice as much air, food and water every day to keep this bonus active.

entries.name: High metabolism
entries.effect: Your PHYSICAL skill checks all have a SMALL bonus. You also recover MINOR TRAUMA on full REST. You need to consume three times as much air, food and water every day to keep this bonus active.

entries.name: High metabolism
entries.effect: Your base MOVEMENT is now 7 and you fully recover your HEALTH, MORALE and MAJOR TRAUMA on full REST. You need to consume four times as much air, food and water every day to keep this bonus active.

entries.name: Hyperawareness
entries.effect: Your AWARENESS skill checks have a SMALL bonus. Your awareness cannot be reduced by external factors (noise, obstacles, lighting etc.)

entries.name: Hyperawareness
entries.effect: Your AWARENESS skill checks have a LARGE bonus. Your awareness cannot be reduced by external factors (noise, obstacles, lighting etc.)

entries.name: Hyperawareness
entries.effect: Your AWARENESS skill checks now ignores any and all types of concealment.

entries.name: Mass improvement
entries.effect: You gain an additional 5 points to your base HEALTH

entries.name: Mass improvement
entries.effect: You recover 1 HEALTH every maintenance as long as you are not suffering from TRAUMA.

entries.name: Mass improvement
entries.effect: Your maximum ENDURANCE is no longer limited by your race. You REGENERATION now works even when suffering from TRAUMA and will keep working until your body is DESTROYED

entries.name: Nerve Dampening
entries.effect: Your ENDURANCE and WILLPOWER have a SMALL bonus when checking for TRAUMA.

entries.name: Nerve Dampening
entries.effect: TRAUMA no longer reduces your defensive attributes.

entries.name: Nerve Dampening
entries.effect: TRAUMA no longer applies any penalties to any ATTRIBUTES. You now gain a SMALL bonus to SOAK mitigation on LIGHT TRAUMA or a LARGE bonus in case of SEVERE TRAUMA.

entries.name: Workaholic
entries.effect: You can function normally without taking a full REST for up to a full week. Doing so cost you 1 MORALE per skipped REST period and you do not gain the benefits of a REST.

entries.name: Workaholic
entries.effect: You now gain your normal recovery if you spend 10 hours of non combat activity.

entries.name: Workaholic
entries.effect: In addition to the previous benefits you can now REST for a SCENE and get the full benefits of a REST

entries.name: Pheromones
entries.effect: You can secrete pheromones on demand (free action). Targets of the same race as you have a SMALL penalty to ALL DEFENSES until the end of the SCENE when touched. This effect can also apply to natural weapons.

entries.name: Pheromones
entries.effect: Your pheromones now work against all living things and can also grant LIFEBANE if you desire.

entries.name: Pheromones
entries.effect: As a COMPLEX action, you can use any non instant drug in your possession to enhance your pheromones; while enhanced you can apply the drug's effect on touch until the end of the SCENE.

entries.name: Super sight
entries.effect: You ignore darkness related penalties, you can now see perfectly in the dark.

entries.name: Super sight
entries.effect: Your vision now see's in all spectrums; you can see heat, radiation, UV, Etc. If it exist and can be seen you can now see it.

entries.name: Super sight
entries.effect: Your vision transcends reality and you can now see into the spirit world, the immaterial and temporal. Concealment against you is impossible unless it's all types.

entries.name: Rebirth
entries.effect: Gain a completely new appearance, DNA and identity. You are impossible to trace from your previous identity. This evolution can be re-taken without costing more EVO points (you still have to pay the cost).

entries.name: Rebirth
entries.effect: You can now perform minor alterations to your person changing colors, height weight by (25% max), voice, hairs, eyes. Changes requires a COMPLEX action.

entries.name: Rebirth
entries.effect: You can now greatly alter your appearance, including sex and DNA at will. You can change to anything as long as it remains within your race limitations. (COMPLEX action for minor changes and SCENE action for major changes).

entries.name: Simplify DNA
entries.effect: Your entire DNA is redesigned to minimize costs. Your backup costs are reduced by 50%

entries.name: Simplify DNA
entries.effect: You commission further improvement into your DNA code. Your Cloning and Medical procedure costs are now also reduced by 50%

entries.name: Simplify DNA
entries.effect: Your DNA is completely bespoke, every single portion of it has been optimized for replication. Genetic EVO's now cost 50% less and also only use half as many EVO points (Total Genetic EVO /2 round up)

entries.name: Skill imprinting
entries.effect: Skill training no longer has to be bought, you have all the knowledge you could ever need stored in your DNA.

entries.name: Skill imprinting
entries.effect: You no longer have to spend time training; skills are imprinted directly into your DNA. (You still need the XP)

entries.name: Skill imprinting
entries.effect: Everything you do feels natural and simple. If an ATTRIBUTE is higher than any skill in its category you can instead use that attribute to roll the SKILL CHECK even if you do not have points in that skill.

entries.name: Blindsenses
entries.effect: All of your senses can now compensate for each others. You ignore any and all sensory penalty unless it impacts all senses at once.

entries.name: Blindsenses
entries.effect: Your heightened senses now grant a SMALL bonus to all ACUITY skills checks.

entries.name: Blindsenses
entries.effect: You can almost sense things before they happen. Gain a LARGE bonus to ENDURANCE, SPEED, WITS and WILLPOWER on reactions, interrupts and surprise defensive rolls.

entries.name: Adrenal control
entries.effect: Any action done via a SURGE now has a SMALL bonus. If that action already had a SMALL bonus increase this to a LARGE bonus.

entries.name: Adrenal control
entries.effect: When using a SURGE you can pick the following effects in addition to the normal ones: gain a COMPLEX action or grant maximum result on a SKILL CHECK.

entries.name: Adrenal control
entries.effect: You control your adrenaline. Once per scene you can give yourself an additional SURGE. This surge does not count against your limit and must be used immediately.

entries.name: Bio-stasis
entries.effect: When DYING you automatically stabilize during the next MAINTENANCE.

entries.name: Bio-stasis
entries.effect: While in the stabilized state you gain the effect of a full REST after the SCENE (recover HEALTH and MORALE). If you reach positive value on both you wake up and end the stabilized state.

entries.name: Bio-stasis
entries.effect: Whenever you acquire the DYING status, you instantly recover from all AILMENTS and TRAUMA.

entries.name: Flawless body
entries.effect: Your lowest PRIMARY ATRIBUTE is increased by 1 and the maximum racial value of that attribute is also increased by 1. Player's choice if all ATTRIBUTES are equal.

entries.name: Flawless body
entries.effect: Your lowest DEFENSIVE ATRIBUTE is increased by 1 and the maximum racial value of that attribute is also increased by 1. Player's choice if all ATTRIBUTES are equal.

entries.name: Flawless body
entries.effect: Increase your Highest PRIMARY and DEFENSIVE ATTRIBUTES by 1 and the maximum racial value for those same ATTRIBUTES is also increased by 1. Player's choice if all ATTRIBUTES are equal.

entries.name: Hyper immunity
entries.effect: You are immune to the critical effect of LIFEBANE and have a LARGE bonus to RECOVERY rolls done against AILMENTS caused by poisons, toxins and gasses.

entries.name: Hyper immunity
entries.effect: The AILMENT recovery bonus now applies to all types of AILMENTS. You also lower TOXICITY of any drugs you take by 1 (minimum 0).

entries.name: Hyper immunity
entries.effect: You are immune to AILMENTS. All ailments fail to apply on you.

entries.name: Synaptic Reinforcement
entries.effect: After using a MENTAL skill, if your next action is to also use a MENTAL skill that skill gains a SMALL bonus. If you already had a SMALL bonus increase this bonus to LARGE.

entries.name: Synaptic Reinforcement
entries.effect: When performing any MENTAL skill that has a skill bonus you gain a LARGE bonus to DEFENSE against all MORALE attacks until next maintenance.

entries.name: Synaptic Reinforcement
entries.effect: When performing any MENTAL skill that requires at least a STANDARD action you reduce the action cost of the next MENTAL skill by one category (COMPLEX -> STANDARD -> QUICK). Skills cannot be reduced under QUICK.

entries.name: Multi purpose organs
entries.effect: You can ignore the first TRAUMA result every SCENE. Subsequent TRAUMA during the same scene will apply normally.

entries.name: Multi purpose organs
entries.effect: Suffering a TRAUMA can never puts you into the DYING state. (You still become DYING if your HEALTH/MORALE reaches 0)

entries.name: Multi purpose organs
entries.effect: Whenever you recover HEALTH or MORALE you also clear ONE associated TRAUMA.

entries.name: Mutation
entries.effect: Gain the EVOLUTION TRAIT from a race of your choice.

entries.name: Mutation
entries.effect: You now have all TRAITS from the selected race (racial, evolution and environment). Your appearance changes to a mix of both race.

entries.name: Mutation
entries.effect: You can now have the traits you want from both races (pick and chose) and the ATTRIBUTES modifiers of your choice (pick and chose which race applies for each attribute).

entries.name: Void soul
entries.effect: Your maximum CHI is always 0. You cannot use spells, relics or gain CHI in any way. You gain a SMALL bonus to all DEFENSES (END, SPD, WITS, WILL) against SPELLS.

entries.name: Void soul
entries.effect: Your DEFENSE bonus against SPELLS increase to a LARGE bonus and when you successfully COUNTERSPELL the caster takes twice the CHI cost of the spell as TRUE damage.

entries.name: Void soul
entries.effect: All of your attacks against CHI users have the SPIRITBANE modifier. Any ally hit by a magic effect you are also hit from will benefit from your LARGE DEFENSE bonus against magic.

entries.name: Appendage Graft
entries.effect: You now have an extra appendage. What this appendage is will be left to the player to choose. The appendage can perform simple tasks that do not require more than grabbing, holding or moving things.

entries.name: Appendage Graft
entries.effect: Your appendage is improved to the point where it can be used to perform normal tasks. You can use it by itself or at the same time as your natural ones. If perform the additional actions treat those actions as dual wield (SMALL penalty to one action LARGE to the other).

entries.name: Appendage Graft
entries.effect: Your appendage is now fully independent and you have only a SMALL penalty to actions made with it and no penalty to other actions.

entries.name: Body of a GOD
entries.effect: When suffering from any TRAUMA you have no penalty to your SOCIAL ATTRIBUTES and WITS DEFENSE

entries.name: Body of a GOD
entries.effect: Your body is designed to never look damaged, any damage you take is invisible to the naked eye. As an added benefit CRITICAL HITS have no additional effects on you.

entries.name: Body of a GOD
entries.effect: TRAUMA no longer lowers your attributes, it instead increases them.

entries.name: Vampirism
entries.effect: You can no longer recover HEALTH or MORALE naturally. Your natural attacks now DRAIN your target's HEALTH or MORALE back to you. As a COMPLEX action you can touch an incapacitated target to DRAIN 3 HEALTH or 3 MORALE (Recover unsaved damage).

entries.name: Vampirism
entries.effect: Your COMPLEX touch drain action can now be done as a point blank MARTIAL ARTS 1m AoE and now works against any target that has previously taken damage, not just incapacitated ones.

entries.name: Vampirism
entries.effect: You now passively recover 1 HEALTH and MORALE during MAINTENANCE for every living thing (excluding you) that took damage within 10m in the previous round.

entries.name: Blank Slate
entries.effect: Your body leaves no DNA evidence, every single cell of your outer body layer is devoid of any identifying information. You also look as generic as possible making identification extremely difficult. (LARGE penalty to identification).

entries.name: Blank Slate
entries.effect: Your body will now fool cameras, scanners, spirits, biometric and sensors. They all have a LARGE penalty on detecting you and can never identify you. You can use the identity of another for a SCENE if you have a LARGE sample of them available (of if they are close by)

entries.name: Blank Slate
entries.effect: You can now leave traces of any identify you choose. Pick anything you want as long as it's a living thing. COMPLEX action to change. You can also replicate the identification of anyone you have touched or had contact with in the last DAY.

entries.name: Optimized Systems
entries.effect:
Passive: Provides a SMALL bonus to one selected ATTRIBUTE (PHYSIQUE, SOCIAL, MENTAL or ACUITY). This bonus cannot raise the attribute over racial maximum.
Active: Raise the selected PRIMARY ATTRIBUTE to your maximum RACIAL value for your next action.

entries.name: Optimized Systems
entries.effect:
Passive: The bonus now applies to all of your PRIMARY attributes not just one.
Active: Raise all PRIMARY ATTRIBUTES to your maximum RACIAL value for your next action.

entries.name: Optimized Systems
entries.effect:
Passive: The passive bonus now allows you to exceed your racial maximum values.
Active: Set all PRIMARY ATTRIBUTES to 10 for your next action.

entries.name: Datacom Implant
entries.effect:
Passive: Provides an implant that can control your datacom with your mind. Datacom actions gain the INV modifier.
Active: You can perform one SCRAMBLE, SCAN, LOCK-ON or OBFUSCATE action as FREE action. (They still cost CPU).

entries.name: Datacom Implant
entries.effect:
Passive: Improves your implant to mask your Datacom actions completely. Datacom actions gain INV+.
Active: Adds GADGETS to the FREE action granted by your implant. (Still cost NANITES).

entries.name: Datacom Implant
entries.effect:
Passive: Your datacom implant now share its MEMORY with your own. You can reserve up to X morale to increase MEMORY by the same amount. 
Active: If you have more than HALF your MORALE reserved as MEMORY, the activation of Datacom Implant is FREE.

entries.name: Cyber Armory
entries.effect:
Passive: Your body can power ENERGY weapons without needing a power pack. Energy weapons sizes can be reduced by 1 category but are only usable by you.
Active: Use your internal systems to bypass the recharge of an energy weapon. Instantly reload an energy weapon.

entries.name: Cyber Armory
entries.effect:
Passive: You can now integrate one ENERGY weapon into your body as long as its modified size is either SMALL or TINY. Internal weapons have PASSIVE CONCEALMENT of 10.
Active: Your instant recharge also repairs your weapon and removes any malfunctions at the same time.

entries.name: Cyber Armory
entries.effect:
Passive: ENERGY weapons wielded by you have a LARGE bonus to their EXPERTISE.
Active: When you instant recharge a weapon, it's next shot will have a LARGE bonus to DAMAGE and POWER is increased to [HIGH].

entries.name: Nanogel Reserves
entries.effect:
Passive: During maintenance you can sacrifice 1 HEALTH to generate 1 NANITE.
Active: You can spend 1 NANITE to restore an equal amount of HEALTH or MORALE to anything within your network.

entries.name: Nanogel Reserves
entries.effect:
Passive: You now have a personal NANITES capacity; increase maximum nanites by 4, this is in addition to any DATACOM NANITES.
Active: You can now spend as much NANITE as you want,  restore an equal amount of HEALTH or MORALE to anything within your network.

entries.name: Nanogel Reserves
entries.effect:
Passive: Generating nanites during MAINTENANCE no longer has a HEALTH cost.
Active: When a target recovers HEALTH or MORALE due to nanogel reserves, they gain the NANITES spent as guaranteed SOAK until next maintenance

entries.name: Assassin's Tools
entries.effect:
Passive: You have a built-in melee weapon (Max size Small) imbedded in one of your limbs along with a poison compartment. Weapon can be readied/hidden away as a free action and count as a natural weapon.
Active: Consume the stored poison before an attack to apply it.

entries.name: Assassin's Tools
entries.effect:
Passive: Your assassin's tools can now accommodate up to a MEDIUM size weapon.
Active: Your poison storage can now store 3 doses of poison or 3 different poisons. Selecting a different poison is a FREE ACTION.

entries.name: Assassin's Tools
entries.effect:
Passive: Your assassin's tools and the chosen weapon no longer register on scans. Passive CONCEALMENT value 10. 
Active: Improves the delivery system of poisons. The selected poison now applies to all attacks (for up to a SCENE or until replaced).

entries.name: Analyser
entries.effect:
Passive: You can perform LOCK-ON actions against targets without a DATACOM. LOCK-ON also grants you a SMALL bonus to all skill checks made against that target.
Active: Perform a deep scan against a LOCK-ON target to increase your bonus to LARGE until next maintenance.

entries.name: Analyser
entries.effect:
Passive: You can now perform one LOCK-ON as a free action each MAINTENANCE.
Active: Deep scanning a target now also reduces the target's DEFENSES by 1 category until next MAINTENANCE.

entries.name: Analyser
entries.effect:
Passive: Your LOCK-ON now includes objects and structures. You also get detailed target information like health, buffs, debuff, ammo count etc.
Active: Activating deep scan also grants the Universal Flaws talent and increase your CRITICAL range by 2.

entries.name: Doppelganger
entries.effect:
Passive: You can change small aspect of your appearance (general appearance like hair, structure and color) including height and weight by ~10%. Changing takes a SCENE .
Active: You can add a natural weapons Knife, Claw or Mace (Player's choice) to your shapechange.

entries.name: Doppelganger
entries.effect:
Passive: You can now perform extensive appearance modifications; appear as another race and can modify your height and weight by up to 50%.
Active: You can shape change as a QUICK action. Doing this will cause 3 HEALTH and MORALE damage to you that cannot be prevented.

entries.name: Doppelganger
entries.effect:
Passive: Your can replicate the appearance of anyone you see. Gain a LARGE bonus to skill check that helps you pass as them.
Active: Replace the passive effect of this implant with one from a T1 GENETIC EVO of your choice (GM approval required). Reactivating this EVO reverts it back.

entries.name: Streetfighter
entries.effect:
Passive: Your natural attacks now have a SMALL bonus to DAMAGE and their base POWER increase to [MEDIUM] (No effect is already higher).
Active: You can activate this implant to perform a natural attack as a QUICK action. This attack counts as a SIMPLE ATTACK.

entries.name: Streetfighter
entries.effect:
Passive: The CRITICAL range of your natural attacks increases by 1 and you gain a SMALL bonus to DEFENSE against MELEE attacks.
Active: Your QUICK natural attacks power is now [HIGH], type changes to ENERGY, gain a LARGE DAMAGE bonus and is EMP.

entries.name: Streetfighter
entries.effect:
Passive: Your natural attacks gain the FULL AUTO ruleset.
Active: The activation bonus can now be applied to COMPLEX actions as well and last until next maintenance.

entries.name: Nanobiotic filters
entries.effect:
Passive: Grants the INNOCULATION special property for a  maximum of a SCENE or 5 minutes.
Active: Gain an immediate RECOVER ROLL to attempt recovery from an AILMENT caused by POISON, DRUGS, TOXIC or GAS.

entries.name: Nanobiotic filters
entries.effect:
Passive: You are now IMMUNE to CONTACT and INGESTED POISONS.
Active: Your RECOVERY roll can now apply to any AILMENT affecting you.

entries.name: Nanobiotic filters
entries.effect:
Passive: Lower the toxicity of all drugs and medicine by 2 (Min 0).
Active: In addition to the RECOVERY roll you can also purge all drugs form your system and reduce your TOXICITY to 0.

entries.name: Personal space
entries.effect:
Passive: When an enemy enters MELEE (1m) range he has to succeed a DC5 Athletic check or be pushed back and knocked prone. This effect cannot trigger again this round.
Active: Force the implant to trigger a second time allowing for a second push. (Max once per round)

entries.name: Personal space
entries.effect:
Passive: The push now deal 6D [HIGH] PHYSICAL HEALTH DAMAGE and the MELEE trigger range increases to 2m.
Active: Supercharge the push, push range is now 10m and athletic DC is set to 10. This EVO will be disabled until the end of the SCENE.

entries.name: Personal space
entries.effect:
Passive: When taking melee damage you can now trigger the Tier 1 active effect for free.
Active: Overcharge the implant to trigger a self destruct that deals 10D +5 [HIGH] PHYSICAL HEALTH Damage in a 10m radius (You take double damage from this effect).

entries.name: Bounty Hunter
entries.effect:
Passive: You now receive bounty information of all targets in your sector whenever you have access to a public network. You can also reserve a mark, this gives you exclusivity on the bounty for a DAY.
Active: Perform a SCAN against any bounty targets at CYBERINTEL 10.

entries.name: Bounty Hunter
entries.effect:
Passive: You can decide whether any damage you deal is STUN damage. You now get paid automatically on bounty completion.
Active: When you SCAN a mark you gain automatic LOCK-ON on the target, The DC to remove that LOCK-ON is 10.

entries.name: Bounty Hunter
entries.effect:
Passive: You now get alerts for and can claim Tier 1 bounties (highest and most dangerous of all).
Active: Your implant now feeds you critical information against your targets. Gain a LARGE bonus to all actions and damage performed against a LOCK-ON target.

entries.name: Gunslinger
entries.effect:
Passive: You can draw and stow away SMALL ranged weapons as a FREE action.
Active: Any SMALL ranged weapon in your posession has the QUICK special attribute until next maintenance.

entries.name: Gunslinger
entries.effect:
Passive: You can now RELOAD one SMALL weapons as a FREE action during MAINTENANCE.
Active: Your REGULAR action behaves like a QUICK action when activating this implant, allowing two "QUICK" shots per round.

entries.name: Gunslinger
entries.effect:
Passive: Gunslinger bonuses now also applies to all MEDIUM ranged weapons as well.
Active: Gunslinger now also grants BURST to any weapon it applies to. BURST is considered a SIMPLE attack while this implant is active.

entries.name: Satisfaction package
entries.effect:
Passive: Your reproductive system can now adapt to match any race within the ALLIANCE database.
Active: Gain a LARGE bonus to… well you know what.

entries.name: Satisfaction package
entries.effect:
Passive: Nanomachines are added to help you eliminate hangovers and toxins. Reduce toxicity by 1 every maintenance.
Active: Delay a TOXIC SHOCK roll by 1 round. If you delay long enough for toxicity to reach 0 you cancel the TOXIC SHOCK entirely.

entries.name: Satisfaction package
entries.effect:
Passive: You can now deliver drugs, poisons and toxins by touch (any body part). You gain immunity to any drug or toxin that you apply this way .
Active: Your body can synthetize one dose of any drugs you have been in contact with within the last DAY.

entries.name: Exterminate Protocols
entries.effect:
Passive: When you have LOCK-ON against a target they gain VULNERABILITY 1.
Active: Activate your exterminator implant against LOCK-ON targets; you gain an AILMENT that prevents non lethal actions until recovered. Your ranged attacks gain X-ALL modifier until next maintenance.

entries.name: Exterminate Protocols
entries.effect:
Passive: Your LOCK-ON against a target now increase to VULNERABILITY 2 and you ignores BAD COVER. 
Active: Your exterminator implant now also grants CRIT and DEADLY until next maintenance.

entries.name: Exterminate Protocols
entries.effect:
Passive: While you have LOCK-ON your damage type will change to target the lowest defense the target has. 
Active: Your exterminator implant now NEGATES ALL SPECIAL MODIFIERS on ARMORS, BARRIERS, DATACOMS and FORCEFIELDS until next maintenance.

entries.name: Combat Analyser
entries.effect:
Passive: You have trajectory prediction built-in your systems. Targeting moving or running targets has no penalty.
Active: You can perform TACTICS skill check as a free action.

entries.name: Combat Analyser
entries.effect:
Passive: You do not incur penalties to skill checks when you move or run.
Active: Successful TACTICS checks against a target increases critical range by 1.

entries.name: Combat Analyser
entries.effect:
Passive: You treat COVER values of your targets as 1 category lower and ignore cover completely on LOCK-ON.
Active: Successful TACTICS checks against a target grants you a LARGE DEFENSE bonus against that target until next maintenance.

entries.name: Mercury Systems
entries.effect:
Passive: Your base MOVEMENT SPEED is now 6.
Active: Your can perform RUN action without moving first until next MAINTENANCE.

entries.name: Mercury Systems
entries.effect:
Passive: Moving now grants you the LARGE SPEED bonus that you normally get when running.
Active: If you RUN your SPEED attribute is set to your maximum racial value until next MAINTENANCE.

entries.name: Mercury Systems
entries.effect:
Passive: Your SHIFT action can be used to perform a regular MOVE action.
Active: Triple your MOVEMENT speed when running (instead of doubling) until next maintenance.

entries.name: Polyglot
entries.effect:
Passive: Your speech capability is now compatible with every sentient species in the galaxy. GAIN a SMALL bonus or SMALL penalty to the target on any skill checks that rely on SPEECH.
Active: Get specific data pertaining to the target or its culture, increase the SMALL bonus to LARGE.

entries.name: Polyglot
entries.effect:
Passive: Your communication now extends to sub sentient species such as animals. Comprehension is still limited by the target's MENTAL attribute.
Active: The critical range of any skill checks where the Polyglot  bonus applies increases by 3. (Crit on a 1-4)

entries.name: Polyglot
entries.effect:
Passive: You now have a LARGE bonus to defenses against anyone you have performed a SOCIAL skill against until the end of the SCENE. 
Active: If the skill action results in MORALE damage against the target you can DOUBLE the damage but the damage changes to STUN.

entries.name: Ironmind
entries.effect:
Passive: Gain a SMALL bonus to your WITS defense.
Active: Get max result on a MORALE SOAK check.

entries.name: Ironmind
entries.effect:
Passive: Gain a LARGE bonus to your WITS defense.
Active: You also negate any TRAUMA, AILMENTS or CRITICAL effects caused from that attack.

entries.name: Ironmind
entries.effect:
Passive: You have AEGIS against any MORALE attacks.
Active: Any damage suffered while this implant is active cannot reduce you below 1 MORALE.

entries.name: Sensory Package
entries.effect:
Passive: Your senses are all enhanced. You have double the normal range for your race. Impairments that effect your senses only cause a SMALL penalty.
Active: Raises you ACUITY to your max racial value until next maintenance but gain VULNERABILITY 1 to damage.

entries.name: Sensory Package
entries.effect:
Passive: You now have a passive awareness of 5 and sensory impairments no longer cause you any penalty.
Active: Activation also increases your WITS to your maximum racial value.

entries.name: Sensory Package
entries.effect:
Passive: You can sense things before they happen. You can no longer be surprised. During a surprise round you treat it as a normal round.
Active: While active you can spot targets through walls and obstacles (max 1m thick) and you ignore concealment values under 6.

entries.name: Scrambler
entries.effect:
Passive: All remote hacking actions within datacom range have a LARGE penalty. Friend and foe (can be toggled off).
Active: Kill all remote communication in datacom range until next maintenance. Remote hacking is impossible.

entries.name: Scrambler
entries.effect:
Passive: While scrambler is active you gain a LARGE bonus to OBFUSCATE checks.
Active: Passive: When killing communications you also apply a SCRAMBLE LARGE penalty to every non allied device within datacom range.

entries.name: Scrambler
entries.effect:
Passive: Remote hacking against your NETWORK is impossible.
Active: When killing communications you also prevent every single device within datacom range from working.

entries.name: Privacy
entries.effect:
Passive: You hardly register on electronic surveillance. You now always have Type II (vs AI and Electronics) passive concealment of 1.
Active: Overcharge your privacy emitter, your CONCEALMENT skill rolls are now Type II, this effect also applies to allies in a 5m radius.

entries.name: Privacy
entries.effect:
Passive: Your gear has a passive CONCEALMENT 6 Vs electronic surveillance.
Active: When activating PRIVACY you now cover allies gear in 5m and legality of all of covered items will show as NO PERMIT to machines until end of the scene.

entries.name: Privacy
entries.effect:
Passive: Everything you have cannot be identified on a SCAN, same goes for you. TACTICS against you grant no benefits.
Active: You can alter the legality and scan result of any items on you or within 5m to whatever you choose. The modified results will last a SCENE.

entries.name: Ironman
entries.effect:
Passive: You have highly optimised metabolic functions. Grants a LARGE bonus to resilience checks.
Active: You can activate this augment to automatically succeed a Resilience check.

entries.name: Ironman
entries.effect:
Passive: You ignore the effects of fatigue and hunger and you can add a RESILIENCE skill checks to TOXIC SHOCK and EVO Psychosis.
Active: You can activate this augment to automatically succeed a TOXICITY or PSYCHOSIS check.

entries.name: Ironman
entries.effect:
Passive: You now ignore the effects of SICK. In addition, AILMENTS can never reduce your ATTRIBUTES.
Active: You can activate this augment to automatically succeed on one RECOVERY check.
