rules_full: Evolution is an optional system. No character is forced to spend resources in this system. It serves as a way to guide players wishing to modify their body, add cybernetics, or dabble in magic.

Every character can have as many EVOs as they can take. Each tier adds its rank to the total EVO points a character has. Those points dictate the severity of consequences tied to having too many EVOs.

Evolution has 3 tiers per category. Before buying a higher tier you must first buy the previous tier in that category. (e.g. To get Alpha Specimen TIER II you also need TIER I — total EVO point increase would be 3.)
Tier 1 evolutions grant some benefits but usually have a small impact on actual gameplay.
Tier 2 evolutions are substantial and grant significant changes to a character.
Tier 3 evolutions provide major benefits but come with a significant cost to credits and EVO total.
Evolution traits add 1 point per tier to your EVO score. If a player acquires a Tier 3 trait (which requires Tiers 1 and 2), the total increase will be 6 points.
Skills required to install an EVO: Medical for Genetics, Technology for Cybernetics, Binding for Magic. Install DC is 2, 4, or 6 depending on EVO tier.
tier_notes: Benefits and drawbacks of various EVO ranks

Tier 1  - Your new genetic code has had some cosmetic changes on your appearance; pick one or more feature from your appearance (color, shape, feature like hair, or horns and mutate them in some way).
Tier 2 - Lifebane critical effect will disable one of your GENETIC EVO's (Player's choice but all 3 tiers) until a recovery roll is made

Tier 3 - Extensive genetic modifications can have a severe impact on drugs and medical treatment. Any drug or medical item used on you has a 50% chance of having no TOXICITY or double TOXICITY. You can order custom drugs to avoid this effect.

Tier 1 - Replacing body parts with machinery does leave some traces. You now have some visible implants on your body. Pick one or more feature from your appearance that represents your Cybernetic EVO (you can customize it to some extent).
Tier 2 - EMP critical effect will disable one of your CYBERNETIC EVO's (Player's choice all 3 tiers) until a recovery roll is made.

Tier 3 - You now count as a MACHINE and no longer COUNT as a LIVING BEING. When you suffer a SEVERE TRAUMA you have a 50% chance that it will instead strike one of your cybernetic EVO's : Negate the TRAUMA and one of your Cybernetic EVO (Player's choice, all 3 tiers) is disabled until repaired.
Passive: Effects that are always on, generates no CYBER SHOCK

Active: Free action to gain the benefits of an active effect, player must roll for CYBER SHOCK: When activating a Cybernetics augment you risk CYBER SHOCK. To avoid this you must roll a TECHNOLOGY skill Vs your curent MORALE value to see if the augment performs normally. Should you fail, the augment works and you lose 1 morale per TIER of this augment. If your morale drops to 0 you lose control of your character.
Tier 1 - EVO magic is done via spirit fusion as tattoos or grafting relics into your flesh. Pick the design and modify one or more of your character's features to reflect this new appearance.
Tier 2 - Spiritbane critical effect will disable one of your MAGIC EVO's (Player's choice all 3 tiers) until a recovery roll is made.

Tier 3 - You no longer count as a LIVING being  while your SPIRIT is active, you instead count as a SPIRIT. Because of your supernatural composure you leak CHI in your environment: Every SCENE you start in has at least 1 RAW CHI in the area.
overflow_rules: There is no hard limit to the number of EVOs a character can have, but past a certain point there is a significant chance of consequences ranging from minor annoyances to full psychosis.
When installing EVOs, compare the total EVO ranks (including the new EVO) against the sum of ENDURANCE + WILLPOWER. If the result is 0 or negative, the body accepts the EVO without complications.

When Attributes Vs EVO is 1 or more, the GM secretly rolls a D10 and subtracts any additional successes the installer got over the install DC. If the GM's total is 1 or more, the recipient gains an EVO affliction.
Afflictions do not manifest right away — a player will never know how bad it is until it is too late.
Triggered when a player makes a critical failure during a SCENE from a roll that could have been influenced by their EVO.
EVO afflictions will never trigger more than once per SCENE.
EVO afflictions are cumulative. When multiple are possible the GM rolls which activates randomly.
Getting cloned resets all of a character's EVOs and any afflictions acquired. Permanent EVOs remain forever.
An EVO can never negate the drawback from one of the afflictions. If an EVO would normally render you immune, you ignore that EVO.

GENETICS: Tier 1 — Your new genetic code has had some cosmetic changes on your appearance; pick one or more features (color, shape, hair, horns etc.) and mutate them.
Tier 2 — Lifebane critical effect will disable one of your GENETIC EVOs (player's choice, all 3 tiers) until a recovery roll is made.
Tier 3 — Extensive modifications can impact drugs and medical treatment. Any drug/medical item used on you has a 50% chance of no TOXICITY or double TOXICITY. Custom drugs can avoid this.
CYBERNETICS: Tier 1 — Replacing body parts with machinery leaves traces. You now have visible implants on your body — pick one or more appearance features representing your Cybernetic EVO.
Tier 2 — EMP critical effect will disable one of your CYBERNETIC EVOs (player's choice, all 3 tiers) until a recovery roll is made.

Tier 3 — You count as a MACHINE and no longer count as a LIVING BEING. On SEVERE TRAUMA there is a 50% chance it strikes one of your Cybernetic EVOs instead, negating the TRAUMA but disabling that EVO until repaired.
Passive EVOs: Always on, generate no CYBER SHOCK.

Active EVOs: Free action to gain benefits. Roll TECHNOLOGY vs current MORALE to avoid CYBER SHOCK. On failure the augment works but you lose 1 MORALE per TIER. If MORALE drops to 0 you lose control of your character.
MAGIC: Tier 1 — EVO magic is done via spirit fusion as tattoos or grafting relics into your flesh. Pick the design and modify one or more of your character's features.
Tier 2 — Spiritbane critical effect will disable one of your MAGIC EVOs (player's choice, all 3 tiers) until a recovery roll is made.

Tier 3 — You no longer count as a LIVING being while your SPIRIT is active; you count as a SPIRIT instead. You leak CHI in your environment — every SCENE you start in has at least 1 RAW CHI in the area.

TIER I.name: Alpha specimen
TIER I.effect: You are a perfect example of how great your race can present itself. Gain a SMALL bonus on all SOCIAL skills when interacting with members of your race.

TIER II.name: Alpha specimen
TIER II.effect: You now appear as perfect to other races as well. Gain a SMALL bonus on all SOCIAL skills when interacting with other races as well.

TIER III.name: Alpha specimen
TIER III.effect: Your presence now borders on the supernatural. Increase SOCIAL attribute by 2 and you can now exceed your race maximum SOCIAL attribute (max 10).

TIER I.name: Chameleon
TIER I.effect: You tend to take on the color of your surroundings, Gain a LARGE bonus to CONCEALMENT skill checks when not moving.

TIER II.name: Chameleon
TIER II.effect: Your body can now morph and change itself to imitate textures and surroundings. You are completely invisible (CONCEALMENT 10) when not moving, otherwise you have LARGE concealment bonus.

TIER III.name: Chameleon
TIER III.effect: Your adaptive camouflage now also produces electronic and psychic interference. Your invisibility works against all detection methods, same for your LARGE concealment bonus when moving.

TIER I.name: Conditioning
TIER I.effect: You can now survive without protective gear in one type of environment (pick one) that would have been detrimental to your race. You still need a comfortable environment to gain the benefits of a REST action (Survival check).

TIER II.name: Conditioning
TIER II.effect: You can now survive in any HARSH environment (high/low heat, pressure, toxic etc.). You still need a comfortable environment to gain the benefits of a REST action (Survival check).

TIER III.name: Conditioning
TIER III.effect: You can now survive in extreme environments (no atmosphere, extreme pressure, extreme heat or cold). You can now gain the benefits of a REST action in a HARSH environment (Survival check).

TIER I.name: DNA optimisation
TIER I.effect: You can exceed your racial PRIMARY ATTRIBUTES by 1 point (PHYSICAL, MENTAL, SOCIAL or ACUITY).

TIER II.name: DNA optimisation
TIER II.effect: You can now also exceed your racial DEFENSIVE ATTRIBUTES by 1 point (SPEED, ENDURANCE, WITS, WILLPOWER)

TIER III.name: DNA optimisation
TIER III.effect: The attribute limit of all of your ATTRIBUTES is increased by 3 points (max 10)

TIER I.name: Hyper Conditioning
TIER I.effect: Your ATTRIBUTES are no longer reduced when suffering from MINOR TRAUMA.

TIER II.name: Hyper Conditioning
TIER II.effect: Your ATTRIBUTES are no longer reduced when suffering from any TRAUMA. When reduced to 0 HEALTH or MORALE you automatically stabilize.

TIER III.name: Hyper Conditioning
TIER III.effect: Your ATTRIBUTES can never be reduced. Maximum duration of any AILMENT on you is now 1 round. (Auto RECOVER on next maintenance).

TIER I.name: Epidural dampening
TIER I.effect: You have damage resistance 1 against STUN damage

TIER II.name: Epidural dampening
TIER II.effect: You have damage resistance 1 against ALL damage

TIER III.name: Epidural dampening
TIER III.effect: Your ENDURANCE and WILLPOWER damage reduction defense checks are always at maximum value. (No roll required)

TIER I.name: Equilibrium
TIER I.effect: The maximum RACIAL value on all of your PRIMARY ATTRIBUTES is now 1 lower. Raise all of your PRIMARY ATRIBUTES by 1 point

TIER II.name: Equilibrium
TIER II.effect: The maximum RACIAL value on all of your DEFENSIVE ATTRIBUTES is now 1 lower. Raise all of your DEFENSIVE ATRIBUTES by 1 point

TIER III.name: Equilibrium
TIER III.effect: The maximum RACIAL value of all of your ATTRIBUTES is now always equal to the highest attribute in that type (primary or defensive).

TIER I.name: Fearless
TIER I.effect: You gain an additional 5 points to your base MORALE. You also recover double MORALE on a REST action.

TIER II.name: Fearless
TIER II.effect: In addition to the morale gain you also can never be BROKEN. Treat any BROKEN result as SHAKEN even if already SHAKEN.

TIER III.name: Fearless
TIER III.effect: You gain an additional 5 point to your base morale (total 10) and treat all MORALE damage as STUN damage.

TIER I.name: High metabolism
TIER I.effect: Your base MOVEMENT is increased to 6 and you recover twice as much HEALTH and MORALE per REST. You need to consume twice as much air, food and water every day to keep this bonus active.

TIER II.name: High metabolism
TIER II.effect: Your PHYSICAL skill checks all have a SMALL bonus. You also recover MINOR TRAUMA on full REST. You need to consume three times as much air, food and water every day to keep this bonus active.

TIER III.name: High metabolism
TIER III.effect: Your base MOVEMENT is now 7 and you fully recover your HEALTH, MORALE and MAJOR TRAUMA on full REST. You need to consume four times as much air, food and water every day to keep this bonus active.

TIER I.name: Hyperawareness
TIER I.effect: Your AWARENESS skill checks have a SMALL bonus. Your awareness cannot be reduced by external factors (noise, obstacles, lighting etc.)

TIER II.name: Hyperawareness
TIER II.effect: Your AWARENESS skill checks have a LARGE bonus. Your awareness cannot be reduced by external factors (noise, obstacles, lighting etc.)

TIER III.name: Hyperawareness
TIER III.effect: Your AWARENESS skill checks now ignores any and all types of concealment.

TIER I.name: Mass improvement
TIER I.effect: You gain an additional 5 points to your base HEALTH

TIER II.name: Mass improvement
TIER II.effect: You recover 1 HEALTH every maintenance as long as you are not suffering from TRAUMA.

TIER III.name: Mass improvement
TIER III.effect: Your maximum ENDURANCE is no longer limited by your race. You REGENERATION now works even when suffering from TRAUMA and will keep working until your body is DESTROYED

TIER I.name: Nerve Dampening
TIER I.effect: Your ENDURANCE and WILLPOWER have a SMALL bonus when checking for TRAUMA.

TIER II.name: Nerve Dampening
TIER II.effect: TRAUMA no longer reduces your defensive attributes.

TIER III.name: Nerve Dampening
TIER III.effect: TRAUMA no longer applies any penalties to any ATTRIBUTES. You now gain a SMALL bonus to SOAK mitigation on LIGHT TRAUMA or a LARGE bonus in case of SEVERE TRAUMA.

TIER I.name: Workaholic
TIER I.effect: You can function normally without taking a full REST for up to a full week. Doing so cost you 1 MORALE per skipped REST period and you do not gain the benefits of a REST.

TIER II.name: Workaholic
TIER II.effect: You now gain your normal recovery if you spend 10 hours of non combat activity.

TIER III.name: Workaholic
TIER III.effect: In addition to the previous benefits you can now REST for a SCENE and get the full benefits of a REST

TIER I.name: Pheromones
TIER I.effect: You can secrete pheromones on demand (free action). Targets of the same race as you have a SMALL penalty to ALL DEFENSES until the end of the SCENE when touched. This effect can also apply to natural weapons.

TIER II.name: Pheromones
TIER II.effect: Your pheromones now work against all living things and can also grant LIFEBANE if you desire.

TIER III.name: Pheromones
TIER III.effect: As a COMPLEX action, you can use any non instant drug in your possession to enhance your pheromones; while enhanced you can apply the drug's effect on touch until the end of the SCENE.

TIER I.name: Super sight
TIER I.effect: You ignore darkness related penalties, you can now see perfectly in the dark.

TIER II.name: Super sight
TIER II.effect: Your vision now see's in all spectrums; you can see heat, radiation, UV, Etc. If it exist and can be seen you can now see it.

TIER III.name: Super sight
TIER III.effect: Your vision transcends reality and you can now see into the spirit world, the immaterial and temporal. Concealment against you is impossible unless it's all types.

TIER I.name: Rebirth
TIER I.effect: Gain a completely new appearance, DNA and identity. You are impossible to trace from your previous identity. This evolution can be re-taken without costing more EVO points (you still have to pay the cost).

TIER II.name: Rebirth
TIER II.effect: You can now perform minor alterations to your person changing colors, height weight by (25% max), voice, hairs, eyes. Changes requires a COMPLEX action.

TIER III.name: Rebirth
TIER III.effect: You can now greatly alter your appearance, including sex and DNA at will. You can change to anything as long as it remains within your race limitations. (COMPLEX action for minor changes and SCENE action for major changes).

TIER I.name: Simplify DNA
TIER I.effect: Your entire DNA is redesigned to minimize costs. Your backup costs are reduced by 50%

TIER II.name: Simplify DNA
TIER II.effect: You commission further improvement into your DNA code. Your Cloning and Medical procedure costs are now also reduced by 50%

TIER III.name: Simplify DNA
TIER III.effect: Your DNA is completely bespoke, every single portion of it has been optimized for replication. Genetic EVO's now cost 50% less and also only use half as many EVO points (Total Genetic EVO /2 round up)

TIER I.name: Skill imprinting
TIER I.effect: Skill training no longer has to be bought, you have all the knowledge you could ever need stored in your DNA.

TIER II.name: Skill imprinting
TIER II.effect: You no longer have to spend time training; skills are imprinted directly into your DNA. (You still need the XP)

TIER III.name: Skill imprinting
TIER III.effect: Everything you do feels natural and simple. If an ATTRIBUTE is higher than any skill in its category you can instead use that attribute to roll the SKILL CHECK even if you do not have points in that skill.

TIER I.name: Blindsenses
TIER I.effect: All of your senses can now compensate for each others. You ignore any and all sensory penalty unless it impacts all senses at once.

TIER II.name: Blindsenses
TIER II.effect: Your heightened senses now grant a SMALL bonus to all ACUITY skills checks.

TIER III.name: Blindsenses
TIER III.effect: You can almost sense things before they happen. Gain a LARGE bonus to ENDURANCE, SPEED, WITS and WILLPOWER on reactions, interrupts and surprise defensive rolls.

TIER I.name: Adrenal control
TIER I.effect: Any action done via a SURGE now has a SMALL bonus. If that action already had a SMALL bonus increase this to a LARGE bonus.

TIER II.name: Adrenal control
TIER II.effect: When using a SURGE you can pick the following effects in addition to the normal ones: gain a COMPLEX action or grant maximum result on a SKILL CHECK.

TIER III.name: Adrenal control
TIER III.effect: You control your adrenaline. Once per scene you can give yourself an additional SURGE. This surge does not count against your limit and must be used immediately.

TIER I.name: Bio-stasis
TIER I.effect: When DYING you automatically stabilize during the next MAINTENANCE.

TIER II.name: Bio-stasis
TIER II.effect: While in the stabilized state you gain the effect of a full REST after the SCENE (recover HEALTH and MORALE). If you reach positive value on both you wake up and end the stabilized state.

TIER III.name: Bio-stasis
TIER III.effect: Whenever you acquire the DYING status, you instantly recover from all AILMENTS and TRAUMA.

TIER I.name: Flawless body
TIER I.effect: Your lowest PRIMARY ATRIBUTE is increased by 1 and the maximum racial value of that attribute is also increased by 1. Player's choice if all ATTRIBUTES are equal.

TIER II.name: Flawless body
TIER II.effect: Your lowest DEFENSIVE ATRIBUTE is increased by 1 and the maximum racial value of that attribute is also increased by 1. Player's choice if all ATTRIBUTES are equal.

TIER III.name: Flawless body
TIER III.effect: Increase your Highest PRIMARY and DEFENSIVE ATTRIBUTES by 1 and the maximum racial value for those same ATTRIBUTES is also increased by 1. Player's choice if all ATTRIBUTES are equal.

TIER I.name: Hyper immunity
TIER I.effect: You are immune to the critical effect of LIFEBANE and have a LARGE bonus to RECOVERY rolls done against AILMENTS caused by poisons, toxins and gasses.

TIER II.name: Hyper immunity
TIER II.effect: The AILMENT recovery bonus now applies to all types of AILMENTS. You also lower TOXICITY of any drugs you take by 1 (minimum 0).

TIER III.name: Hyper immunity
TIER III.effect: You are immune to AILMENTS. All ailments fail to apply on you.

TIER I.name: Synaptic Reinforcement
TIER I.effect: After using a MENTAL skill, if your next action is to also use a MENTAL skill that skill gains a SMALL bonus. If you already had a SMALL bonus increase this bonus to LARGE.

TIER II.name: Synaptic Reinforcement
TIER II.effect: When performing any MENTAL skill that has a skill bonus you gain a LARGE bonus to DEFENSE against all MORALE attacks until next maintenance.

TIER III.name: Synaptic Reinforcement
TIER III.effect: When performing any MENTAL skill that requires at least a STANDARD action you reduce the action cost of the next MENTAL skill by one category (COMPLEX -> STANDARD -> QUICK). Skills cannot be reduced under QUICK.

TIER I.name: Multi purpose organs
TIER I.effect: You can ignore the first TRAUMA result every SCENE. Subsequent TRAUMA during the same scene will apply normally.

TIER II.name: Multi purpose organs
TIER II.effect: Suffering a TRAUMA can never puts you into the DYING state. (You still become DYING if your HEALTH/MORALE reaches 0)

TIER III.name: Multi purpose organs
TIER III.effect: Whenever you recover HEALTH or MORALE you also clear ONE associated TRAUMA.

TIER I.name: Mutation
TIER I.effect: Gain the EVOLUTION TRAIT from a race of your choice.

TIER II.name: Mutation
TIER II.effect: You now have all TRAITS from the selected race (racial, evolution and environment). Your appearance changes to a mix of both race.

TIER III.name: Mutation
TIER III.effect: You can now have the traits you want from both races (pick and chose) and the ATTRIBUTES modifiers of your choice (pick and chose which race applies for each attribute).

TIER I.name: Void soul
TIER I.effect: Your maximum CHI is always 0. You cannot use spells, relics or gain CHI in any way. You gain a SMALL bonus to all DEFENSES (END, SPD, WITS, WILL) against SPELLS.

TIER II.name: Void soul
TIER II.effect: Your DEFENSE bonus against SPELLS increase to a LARGE bonus and when you successfully COUNTERSPELL the caster takes twice the CHI cost of the spell as TRUE damage.

TIER III.name: Void soul
TIER III.effect: All of your attacks against CHI users have the SPIRITBANE modifier. Any ally hit by a magic effect you are also hit from will benefit from your LARGE DEFENSE bonus against magic.

TIER I.name: Appendage Graft
TIER I.effect: You now have an extra appendage. What this appendage is will be left to the player to choose. The appendage can perform simple tasks that do not require more than grabbing, holding or moving things.

TIER II.name: Appendage Graft
TIER II.effect: Your appendage is improved to the point where it can be used to perform normal tasks. You can use it by itself or at the same time as your natural ones. If perform the additional actions treat those actions as dual wield (SMALL penalty to one action LARGE to the other).

TIER III.name: Appendage Graft
TIER III.effect: Your appendage is now fully independent and you have only a SMALL penalty to actions made with it and no penalty to other actions.

TIER I.name: Body of a GOD
TIER I.effect: When suffering from any TRAUMA you have no penalty to your SOCIAL ATTRIBUTES and WITS DEFENSE

TIER II.name: Body of a GOD
TIER II.effect: Your body is designed to never look damaged, any damage you take is invisible to the naked eye. As an added benefit CRITICAL HITS have no additional effects on you.

TIER III.name: Body of a GOD
TIER III.effect: TRAUMA no longer lowers your attributes, it instead increases them.

TIER I.name: Vampirism
TIER I.effect: You can no longer recover HEALTH or MORALE naturally. Your natural attacks now DRAIN your target's HEALTH or MORALE back to you. As a COMPLEX action you can touch an incapacitated target to DRAIN 3 HEALTH or 3 MORALE (Recover unsaved damage).

TIER II.name: Vampirism
TIER II.effect: Your COMPLEX touch drain action can now be done as a point blank MARTIAL ARTS 1m AoE and now works against any target that has previously taken damage, not just incapacitated ones.

TIER III.name: Vampirism
TIER III.effect: You now passively recover 1 HEALTH and MORALE during MAINTENANCE for every living thing (excluding you) that took damage within 10m in the previous round.

TIER I.name: Blank Slate
TIER I.effect: Your body leaves no DNA evidence, every single cell of your outer body layer is devoid of any identifying information. You also look as generic as possible making identification extremely difficult. (LARGE penalty to identification).

TIER II.name: Blank Slate
TIER II.effect: Your body will now fool cameras, scanners, spirits, biometric and sensors. They all have a LARGE penalty on detecting you and can never identify you. You can use the identity of another for a SCENE if you have a LARGE sample of them available (of if they are close by)

TIER III.name: Blank Slate
TIER III.effect: You can now leave traces of any identify you choose. Pick anything you want as long as it's a living thing. COMPLEX action to change. You can also replicate the identification of anyone you have touched or had contact with in the last DAY.

TIER I.name: Optimized Systems
TIER I.effect:
Passive: Provides a SMALL bonus to one selected ATTRIBUTE (PHYSIQUE, SOCIAL, MENTAL or ACUITY). This bonus cannot raise the attribute over racial maximum.
Active: Raise the selected PRIMARY ATTRIBUTE to your maximum RACIAL value for your next action.

TIER II.name: Optimized Systems
TIER II.effect:
Passive: The bonus now applies to all of your PRIMARY attributes not just one.
Active: Raise all PRIMARY ATTRIBUTES to your maximum RACIAL value for your next action.

TIER III.name: Optimized Systems
TIER III.effect:
Passive: The passive bonus now allows you to exceed your racial maximum values.
Active: Set all PRIMARY ATTRIBUTES to 10 for your next action.

TIER I.name: Datacom Implant
TIER I.effect:
Passive: Provides an implant that can control your datacom with your mind. Datacom actions gain the INV modifier.
Active: You can perform one SCRAMBLE, SCAN, LOCK-ON or OBFUSCATE action as FREE action. (They still cost CPU).

TIER II.name: Datacom Implant
TIER II.effect:
Passive: Improves your implant to mask your Datacom actions completely. Datacom actions gain INV+.
Active: Adds GADGETS to the FREE action granted by your implant. (Still cost NANITES).

TIER III.name: Datacom Implant
TIER III.effect:
Passive: Your datacom implant now share its MEMORY with your own. You can reserve up to X morale to increase MEMORY by the same amount. 
Active: If you have more than HALF your MORALE reserved as MEMORY, the activation of Datacom Implant is FREE.

TIER I.name: Cyber Armory
TIER I.effect:
Passive: Your body can power ENERGY weapons without needing a power pack. Energy weapons sizes can be reduced by 1 category but are only usable by you.
Active: Use your internal systems to bypass the recharge of an energy weapon. Instantly reload an energy weapon.

TIER II.name: Cyber Armory
TIER II.effect:
Passive: You can now integrate one ENERGY weapon into your body as long as its modified size is either SMALL or TINY. Internal weapons have PASSIVE CONCEALMENT of 10.
Active: Your instant recharge also repairs your weapon and removes any malfunctions at the same time.

TIER III.name: Cyber Armory
TIER III.effect:
Passive: ENERGY weapons wielded by you have a LARGE bonus to their EXPERTISE.
Active: When you instant recharge a weapon, it's next shot will have a LARGE bonus to DAMAGE and POWER is increased to [HIGH].

TIER I.name: Nanogel Reserves
TIER I.effect:
Passive: During maintenance you can sacrifice 1 HEALTH to generate 1 NANITE.
Active: You can spend 1 NANITE to restore an equal amount of HEALTH or MORALE to anything within your network.

TIER II.name: Nanogel Reserves
TIER II.effect:
Passive: You now have a personal NANITES capacity; increase maximum nanites by 4, this is in addition to any DATACOM NANITES.
Active: You can now spend as much NANITE as you want,  restore an equal amount of HEALTH or MORALE to anything within your network.

TIER III.name: Nanogel Reserves
TIER III.effect:
Passive: Generating nanites during MAINTENANCE no longer has a HEALTH cost.
Active: When a target recovers HEALTH or MORALE due to nanogel reserves, they gain the NANITES spent as guaranteed SOAK until next maintenance

TIER I.name: Assassin's Tools
TIER I.effect:
Passive: You have a built-in melee weapon (Max size Small) imbedded in one of your limbs along with a poison compartment. Weapon can be readied/hidden away as a free action and count as a natural weapon.
Active: Consume the stored poison before an attack to apply it.

TIER II.name: Assassin's Tools
TIER II.effect:
Passive: Your assassin's tools can now accommodate up to a MEDIUM size weapon.
Active: Your poison storage can now store 3 doses of poison or 3 different poisons. Selecting a different poison is a FREE ACTION.

TIER III.name: Assassin's Tools
TIER III.effect:
Passive: Your assassin's tools and the chosen weapon no longer register on scans. Passive CONCEALMENT value 10. 
Active: Improves the delivery system of poisons. The selected poison now applies to all attacks (for up to a SCENE or until replaced).

TIER I.name: Analyser
TIER I.effect:
Passive: You can perform LOCK-ON actions against targets without a DATACOM. LOCK-ON also grants you a SMALL bonus to all skill checks made against that target.
Active: Perform a deep scan against a LOCK-ON target to increase your bonus to LARGE until next maintenance.

TIER II.name: Analyser
TIER II.effect:
Passive: You can now perform one LOCK-ON as a free action each MAINTENANCE.
Active: Deep scanning a target now also reduces the target's DEFENSES by 1 category until next MAINTENANCE.

TIER III.name: Analyser
TIER III.effect:
Passive: Your LOCK-ON now includes objects and structures. You also get detailed target information like health, buffs, debuff, ammo count etc.
Active: Activating deep scan also grants the Universal Flaws talent and increase your CRITICAL range by 2.

TIER I.name: Doppelganger
TIER I.effect:
Passive: You can change small aspect of your appearance (general appearance like hair, structure and color) including height and weight by ~10%. Changing takes a SCENE .
Active: You can add a natural weapons Knife, Claw or Mace (Player's choice) to your shapechange.

TIER II.name: Doppelganger
TIER II.effect:
Passive: You can now perform extensive appearance modifications; appear as another race and can modify your height and weight by up to 50%.
Active: You can shape change as a QUICK action. Doing this will cause 3 HEALTH and MORALE damage to you that cannot be prevented.

TIER III.name: Doppelganger
TIER III.effect:
Passive: Your can replicate the appearance of anyone you see. Gain a LARGE bonus to skill check that helps you pass as them.
Active: Replace the passive effect of this implant with one from a T1 GENETIC EVO of your choice (GM approval required). Reactivating this EVO reverts it back.

TIER I.name: Streetfighter
TIER I.effect:
Passive: Your natural attacks now have a SMALL bonus to DAMAGE and their base POWER increase to [MEDIUM] (No effect is already higher).
Active: You can activate this implant to perform a natural attack as a QUICK action. This attack counts as a SIMPLE ATTACK.

TIER II.name: Streetfighter
TIER II.effect:
Passive: The CRITICAL range of your natural attacks increases by 1 and you gain a SMALL bonus to DEFENSE against MELEE attacks.
Active: Your QUICK natural attacks power is now [HIGH], type changes to ENERGY, gain a LARGE DAMAGE bonus and is EMP.

TIER III.name: Streetfighter
TIER III.effect:
Passive: Your natural attacks gain the FULL AUTO ruleset.
Active: The activation bonus can now be applied to COMPLEX actions as well and last until next maintenance.

TIER I.name: Nanobiotic filters
TIER I.effect:
Passive: Grants the INNOCULATION special property for a  maximum of a SCENE or 5 minutes.
Active: Gain an immediate RECOVER ROLL to attempt recovery from an AILMENT caused by POISON, DRUGS, TOXIC or GAS.

TIER II.name: Nanobiotic filters
TIER II.effect:
Passive: You are now IMMUNE to CONTACT and INGESTED POISONS.
Active: Your RECOVERY roll can now apply to any AILMENT affecting you.

TIER III.name: Nanobiotic filters
TIER III.effect:
Passive: Lower the toxicity of all drugs and medicine by 2 (Min 0).
Active: In addition to the RECOVERY roll you can also purge all drugs form your system and reduce your TOXICITY to 0.

TIER I.name: Personal space
TIER I.effect:
Passive: When an enemy enters MELEE (1m) range he has to succeed a DC5 Athletic check or be pushed back and knocked prone. This effect cannot trigger again this round.
Active: Force the implant to trigger a second time allowing for a second push. (Max once per round)

TIER II.name: Personal space
TIER II.effect:
Passive: The push now deal 6D [HIGH] PHYSICAL HEALTH DAMAGE and the MELEE trigger range increases to 2m.
Active: Supercharge the push, push range is now 10m and athletic DC is set to 10. This EVO will be disabled until the end of the SCENE.

TIER III.name: Personal space
TIER III.effect:
Passive: When taking melee damage you can now trigger the Tier 1 active effect for free.
Active: Overcharge the implant to trigger a self destruct that deals 10D +5 [HIGH] PHYSICAL HEALTH Damage in a 10m radius (You take double damage from this effect).

TIER I.name: Bounty Hunter
TIER I.effect:
Passive: You now receive bounty information of all targets in your sector whenever you have access to a public network. You can also reserve a mark, this gives you exclusivity on the bounty for a DAY.
Active: Perform a SCAN against any bounty targets at CYBERINTEL 10.

TIER II.name: Bounty Hunter
TIER II.effect:
Passive: You can decide whether any damage you deal is STUN damage. You now get paid automatically on bounty completion.
Active: When you SCAN a mark you gain automatic LOCK-ON on the target, The DC to remove that LOCK-ON is 10.

TIER III.name: Bounty Hunter
TIER III.effect:
Passive: You now get alerts for and can claim Tier 1 bounties (highest and most dangerous of all).
Active: Your implant now feeds you critical information against your targets. Gain a LARGE bonus to all actions and damage performed against a LOCK-ON target.

TIER I.name: Gunslinger
TIER I.effect:
Passive: You can draw and stow away SMALL ranged weapons as a FREE action.
Active: Any SMALL ranged weapon in your posession has the QUICK special attribute until next maintenance.

TIER II.name: Gunslinger
TIER II.effect:
Passive: You can now RELOAD one SMALL weapons as a FREE action during MAINTENANCE.
Active: Your REGULAR action behaves like a QUICK action when activating this implant, allowing two "QUICK" shots per round.

TIER III.name: Gunslinger
TIER III.effect:
Passive: Gunslinger bonuses now also applies to all MEDIUM ranged weapons as well.
Active: Gunslinger now also grants BURST to any weapon it applies to. BURST is considered a SIMPLE attack while this implant is active.

TIER I.name: Satisfaction package
TIER I.effect:
Passive: Your reproductive system can now adapt to match any race within the ALLIANCE database.
Active: Gain a LARGE bonus to… well you know what.

TIER II.name: Satisfaction package
TIER II.effect:
Passive: Nanomachines are added to help you eliminate hangovers and toxins. Reduce toxicity by 1 every maintenance.
Active: Delay a TOXIC SHOCK roll by 1 round. If you delay long enough for toxicity to reach 0 you cancel the TOXIC SHOCK entirely.

TIER III.name: Satisfaction package
TIER III.effect:
Passive: You can now deliver drugs, poisons and toxins by touch (any body part). You gain immunity to any drug or toxin that you apply this way .
Active: Your body can synthetize one dose of any drugs you have been in contact with within the last DAY.

TIER I.name: Exterminate Protocols
TIER I.effect:
Passive: When you have LOCK-ON against a target they gain VULNERABILITY 1.
Active: Activate your exterminator implant against LOCK-ON targets; you gain an AILMENT that prevents non lethal actions until recovered. Your ranged attacks gain X-ALL modifier until next maintenance.

TIER II.name: Exterminate Protocols
TIER II.effect:
Passive: Your LOCK-ON against a target now increase to VULNERABILITY 2 and you ignores BAD COVER. 
Active: Your exterminator implant now also grants CRIT and DEADLY until next maintenance.

TIER III.name: Exterminate Protocols
TIER III.effect:
Passive: While you have LOCK-ON your damage type will change to target the lowest defense the target has. 
Active: Your exterminator implant now NEGATES ALL SPECIAL MODIFIERS on ARMORS, BARRIERS, DATACOMS and FORCEFIELDS until next maintenance.

TIER I.name: Combat Analyser
TIER I.effect:
Passive: You have trajectory prediction built-in your systems. Targeting moving or running targets has no penalty.
Active: You can perform TACTICS skill check as a free action.

TIER II.name: Combat Analyser
TIER II.effect:
Passive: You do not incur penalties to skill checks when you move or run.
Active: Successful TACTICS checks against a target increases critical range by 1.

TIER III.name: Combat Analyser
TIER III.effect:
Passive: You treat COVER values of your targets as 1 category lower and ignore cover completely on LOCK-ON.
Active: Successful TACTICS checks against a target grants you a LARGE DEFENSE bonus against that target until next maintenance.

TIER I.name: Mercury Systems
TIER I.effect:
Passive: Your base MOVEMENT SPEED is now 6.
Active: Your can perform RUN action without moving first until next MAINTENANCE.

TIER II.name: Mercury Systems
TIER II.effect:
Passive: Moving now grants you the LARGE SPEED bonus that you normally get when running.
Active: If you RUN your SPEED attribute is set to your maximum racial value until next MAINTENANCE.

TIER III.name: Mercury Systems
TIER III.effect:
Passive: Your SHIFT action can be used to perform a regular MOVE action.
Active: Triple your MOVEMENT speed when running (instead of doubling) until next maintenance.

TIER I.name: Polyglot
TIER I.effect:
Passive: Your speech capability is now compatible with every sentient species in the galaxy. GAIN a SMALL bonus or SMALL penalty to the target on any skill checks that rely on SPEECH.
Active: Get specific data pertaining to the target or its culture, increase the SMALL bonus to LARGE.

TIER II.name: Polyglot
TIER II.effect:
Passive: Your communication now extends to sub sentient species such as animals. Comprehension is still limited by the target's MENTAL attribute.
Active: The critical range of any skill checks where the Polyglot  bonus applies increases by 3. (Crit on a 1-4)

TIER III.name: Polyglot
TIER III.effect:
Passive: You now have a LARGE bonus to defenses against anyone you have performed a SOCIAL skill against until the end of the SCENE. 
Active: If the skill action results in MORALE damage against the target you can DOUBLE the damage but the damage changes to STUN.

TIER I.name: Ironmind
TIER I.effect:
Passive: Gain a SMALL bonus to your WITS defense.
Active: Get max result on a MORALE SOAK check.

TIER II.name: Ironmind
TIER II.effect:
Passive: Gain a LARGE bonus to your WITS defense.
Active: You also negate any TRAUMA, AILMENTS or CRITICAL effects caused from that attack.

TIER III.name: Ironmind
TIER III.effect:
Passive: You have AEGIS against any MORALE attacks.
Active: Any damage suffered while this implant is active cannot reduce you below 1 MORALE.

TIER I.name: Sensory Package
TIER I.effect:
Passive: Your senses are all enhanced. You have double the normal range for your race. Impairments that effect your senses only cause a SMALL penalty.
Active: Raises you ACUITY to your max racial value until next maintenance but gain VULNERABILITY 1 to damage.

TIER II.name: Sensory Package
TIER II.effect:
Passive: You now have a passive awareness of 5 and sensory impairments no longer cause you any penalty.
Active: Activation also increases your WITS to your maximum racial value.

TIER III.name: Sensory Package
TIER III.effect:
Passive: You can sense things before they happen. You can no longer be surprised. During a surprise round you treat it as a normal round.
Active: While active you can spot targets through walls and obstacles (max 1m thick) and you ignore concealment values under 6.

TIER I.name: Scrambler
TIER I.effect:
Passive: All remote hacking actions within datacom range have a LARGE penalty. Friend and foe (can be toggled off).
Active: Kill all remote communication in datacom range until next maintenance. Remote hacking is impossible.

TIER II.name: Scrambler
TIER II.effect:
Passive: While scrambler is active you gain a LARGE bonus to OBFUSCATE checks.
Active: Passive: When killing communications you also apply a SCRAMBLE LARGE penalty to every non allied device within datacom range.

TIER III.name: Scrambler
TIER III.effect:
Passive: Remote hacking against your NETWORK is impossible.
Active: When killing communications you also prevent every single device within datacom range from working.

TIER I.name: Privacy
TIER I.effect:
Passive: You hardly register on electronic surveillance. You now always have Type II (vs AI and Electronics) passive concealment of 1.
Active: Overcharge your privacy emitter, your CONCEALMENT skill rolls are now Type II, this effect also applies to allies in a 5m radius.

TIER II.name: Privacy
TIER II.effect:
Passive: Your gear has a passive CONCEALMENT 6 Vs electronic surveillance.
Active: When activating PRIVACY you now cover allies gear in 5m and legality of all of covered items will show as NO PERMIT to machines until end of the scene.

TIER III.name: Privacy
TIER III.effect:
Passive: Everything you have cannot be identified on a SCAN, same goes for you. TACTICS against you grant no benefits.
Active: You can alter the legality and scan result of any items on you or within 5m to whatever you choose. The modified results will last a SCENE.

TIER I.name: Ironman
TIER I.effect:
Passive: You have highly optimised metabolic functions. Grants a LARGE bonus to resilience checks.
Active: You can activate this augment to automatically succeed a Resilience check.

TIER II.name: Ironman
TIER II.effect:
Passive: You ignore the effects of fatigue and hunger and you can add a RESILIENCE skill checks to TOXIC SHOCK and EVO Psychosis.
Active: You can activate this augment to automatically succeed a TOXICITY or PSYCHOSIS check.

TIER III.name: Ironman
TIER III.effect:
Passive: You now ignore the effects of SICK. In addition, AILMENTS can never reduce your ATTRIBUTES.
Active: You can activate this augment to automatically succeed on one RECOVERY check.

TIER I.name: Subdermal Plating
TIER I.effect:
Passive: Pick a LIGHT ARMOR of your choice, you have that armor embeded in you permanently. You ignores the armor's encumbrance.
Active: Repair any cosmetic damage the host may have suffered. The host will appear undamaged.

TIER II.name: Subdermal Plating
TIER II.effect:
Passive: Your armored subframe is improved to allow implantations of a MEDIUM ARMOR of your choice. You ignores the armor's encumbrance.
Active: Increase all defenses to [HIGH] and gain BUNKER, until next maintenance.

TIER III.name: Subdermal Plating
TIER III.effect:
Passive: Your subdermal armor is improved to allow inclusions of an HEAVY ARMOR of your choice. You ignores the armor's encumbrance.
Active: Instead of just repairing cosmetic damage this version actually repairs damage. Recover 3 HEALTH and gain the HEALING modifier on activation.

TIER I.name: Exx-Tend Limbs
TIER I.effect:
Passive: Your limbs can extend beyond their normal reach. Increase TOUCH/MELEE range by 1m.
Active: Super extend your arms and limbs and gain a Melee reach of 10m for your next action

TIER II.name: Exx-Tend Limbs
TIER II.effect:
Passive: Your limbs can now withstand extreme conditions. Your max pull/push/lift weight and volume is doubled.
Active: Lock your limbs and arms in place.  Until next maintenance you cannot perform any other action but your limbs can hold/stop anything up to 100x your normal push/pull value.

TIER III.name: Exx-Tend Limbs
TIER III.effect:
Passive: Your limbs can now be detached and operate independently within DATACOM range. Treat them as DRONES with 1 SYSTEM.
Active: Each of your detached limbs can perform one STANDARD action when the host uses its STANDARD action.

TIER I.name: EMP shields
TIER I.effect:
Passive: You now have a built in SMALL COMBAT FORCEFIELD within you. Forcefield is undetectable and does not recharge on its own (see active).
Active: Recharge your built in FORCEFIELD. This can only be done during MAINTENANCE.

TIER II.name: EMP shields
TIER II.effect:
Passive: While your personal FORCEFIELD has charges left, EMP damage has no additional effects on you.
Active: If you recharged your forcefield during MAINTENANCE it gains the BREAKER special attribute until next maintenance.

TIER III.name: EMP shields
TIER III.effect:
Passive: Your personal FORCEFIELD grants you AEGIS.
Active: When recharging you can change the effect of your forcefield to be a FORCE SHIELD (Gain DEFLECTOR) or GENERATOR (10m) until next maintenance.

TIER I.name: Nanodoctor
TIER I.effect:
Passive: While suffering from any TRAUMA you recover 1 HEALTH every MAINTENANCE phase.
Active: You can spend X NANITES to increase the recovery by that same amount.

TIER II.name: Nanodoctor
TIER II.effect:
Passive: Any recovery of HEALTH are doubled when you are suffering from SEVERE TRAUMA.
Active: Instead of increasing healing you can spend 1 NANITE to recover from a TRAUMA. (1 per TRAUMA).

TIER III.name: Nanodoctor
TIER III.effect:
Passive: Whenever you suffer a TRAUMA, roll a D10 on 7+ you ignore the TRAUMA.
Active: You can now spend NANITES to recover from any AILMENTS. (1 per AILMENT).

TIER I.name: Sub processor
TIER I.effect:
Passive: You can now have 1 drone permanently active without CPU cost (additional drones will cost CPU).
Active: Gain a LARGE bonus to one DRONE action until next maintenance.

TIER II.name: Sub processor
TIER II.effect:
Passive: During MAINTENANCE a drone under your control can perform one CYBERINTEL action (SCRAMBLE, LOCK-ON or SCAN) as a FREE action.
Active: You can now apply the LARGE bonus to the defense rolls of a DRONE instead of an action.

TIER III.name: Sub processor
TIER III.effect:
Passive: Add HACKING to the list of free skills your drone can perform during maintenance.
Active: Whenever you activate this implant, your drone has all of your skills ranks until next maintenance.

TIER I.name: Ghost
TIER I.effect:
Passive: Your body has optical camouflage (Type I,  LARGE bonus to CONCEALMENT) when not moving. You can now make concealment checks in plain sight but at a LARGE penalty. 
Active: Turn invisible, set CONCEALMENT skill value to 10 until you move or perform an action.

TIER II.name: Ghost
TIER II.effect:
Passive: Your camouflage now works Vs. technology (Type II camouflage, Gain passive CONCEALMENT 5 Vs technology) .
Active: The passive effects of Ghost now applies to all allies touching you.

TIER III.name: Ghost
TIER III.effect:
Passive: Increase the passive CONCEALMENT Vs Technology to 10. Your LARGE bonus to CONCEALMENT is now always active.
Active: When activating Ghost, any footage of you since the beggining to the SCENE are removed from any technological devices that could see or detect you.

TIER I.name: Immortalis
TIER I.effect:
Passive: Suffering from TRAUMA no longer reduces your DEFENSIVE attributes.
Active: Increase your SOAK against all damage by 5D until the next maintenance phase.

TIER II.name: Immortalis
TIER II.effect:
Passive: Your DEFENSIVE ATTRIBUTES are now increased by TRAUMA instead of being reduced.
Active: The SOAK bonus is increased to 10D.

TIER III.name: Immortalis
TIER III.effect:
Passive: When gaining any TRAUMA you also gain the active effect of Immortalis for free.
Active: While active you gain the benefits of AEGIS and MASTERWORK

TIER I.name: Exo Behemoth
TIER I.effect:
Passive: When suffering damage you gain a SMALL bonus to all DEFENSES until next maintenance.
Active: Manually activate your passive benefit without having to take damage first.

TIER II.name: Exo Behemoth
TIER II.effect:
Passive: When suffering damage, any subsequent hits cannot cause TRAUMA until next maintenance.
Active: While active you gain a LARGE bonus to all PHYSICAL skills.

TIER III.name: Exo Behemoth
TIER III.effect:
Passive: The bonus when suffering damage is increased to LARGE and grants an immediate RECOVER roll against any ailments you are suffering from.
Active: Until next maintenance, your HEALTH and MORALE cannot drop under your ENDURANCE or WILLPOWER values.

TIER I.name: Open Mind
TIER I.effect: Your maximum CHI is increased by 2

TIER II.name: Open Mind
TIER II.effect: You max chi bonus increases to 3 CHI and when you counter spell you recover the chi spent by the caster.

TIER III.name: Open Mind
TIER III.effect: Whenever a source other than you adds CHI to the RAW pool you gain an equal amount of CHI

TIER I.name: Spirit Infusion
TIER I.effect: When your spirit is SUPRESSED; you gain a SMALL bonus to all PRIMARY ATTRIBUTES. No effect if you do not POSESS a SPIRIT or have no CHI.

TIER II.name: Spirit Infusion
TIER II.effect: While SUPRESSED your spirit grants a SMALL damage bonus to any attacks.Damage bonus is LARGE if the spirit is MAJOR or GOD.

TIER III.name: Spirit Infusion
TIER III.effect: While SUPRESSED your spirit grants a SMALL bonus to all DEFENSES.The bonus is LARGE if the spirit is MAJOR or GOD.

TIER I.name: Chaos Magic
TIER I.effect: Casting spells from RAW CHI lowers their cost by 1 CHI (Min 1).

TIER II.name: Chaos Magic
TIER II.effect: When rolling for backlash your controll check is LUCKY.

TIER III.name: Chaos Magic
TIER III.effect: When using RAW CHI to perform spells, all spell variables have a LARGE bonus if the RAW CHI pool has any CHI remaining. (Increase is after substracting your CHI cost from the RAW pool and you must succeed in the control check.)

TIER I.name: Sealed Mind
TIER I.effect: Your SPIRIT cannot awaken past the PASSIVE state but all your DEFENSES and SOAK are LUCKY vs any CHI or RELIC attacks.

TIER II.name: Sealed Mind
TIER II.effect: When a SPELL successfully bypasses your DEFENSES you recover the CHI cost of the SPELL and gain a LARGE bonus to the next SPELL you use within the next ROUND.

TIER III.name: Sealed Mind
TIER III.effect: Your SPIRIT cannot be bound anymore. When someone succeeds a BINDING checks against you they are instead binding themselves to you; you can then use their CHI as your own.

TIER I.name: Residual Energy
TIER I.effect: When near (within 10m) a recently dead body (same SCENE) you gain a SMALL bonus to all skills.

TIER II.name: Residual Energy
TIER II.effect: When near (within 10m) a recently dead body (same SCENE) has a SKILL rating higher than your own you gain a LARGE bonus to that skill.

TIER III.name: Residual Energy
TIER III.effect: You can touch a recently dead body as a STANDARD action to gain access to all of their SKILLs until the end of the SCENE.

TIER I.name: Spirit Monk
TIER I.effect: You can spend 1 CHI as a FREE action on any unarmed or natural weapon attacks to gain a LARGE bonus to damage with a 1m AoE radius

TIER II.name: Spirit Monk
TIER II.effect: When making an unarmed or natural weapon attack you can replace the attack with a known spell's effect. All spell variable paramaters are based on your MARTIAL ARTS result.

TIER III.name: Spirit Monk
TIER III.effect: Any spells or attacks done in melee range treat the target as BREACHED.

TIER I.name: Synergy
TIER I.effect: When standing adjascent to a willing ally with a BOUND SPIRIT. You can use their SPELLS, BARRIERS and POWERS using your CHI.

TIER II.name: Synergy
TIER II.effect: The effect is now available as long as you are in the same SCENE as your willing allies. You no longer need to be adjascent to them.

TIER III.name: Synergy
TIER III.effect: The effect is no longer limited to WILLING allies. Anyone with a BOUND SPIRIT in the same SCENE as you has their SPELLS, BARRIERS and POWERS available for your usage.

TIER I.name: Supernatural health
TIER I.effect: After a FULL rest, whenever your spirit is not SUPRESSED, you increase your maximum HEALTH or MORALE by 5 points. (Player's choice after a full rest).

TIER II.name: Supernatural health
TIER II.effect: You no longer have to pick HEALTH or MORALE; you now gain both all the time. In addition, should your spirit ever be supressed without consent you instantly recover 5 HEALTH and MORALE.

TIER III.name: Supernatural health
TIER III.effect: While you spirit is not SUPPRESSED you immediately recover an amount of HEALTH and MORALE equal to the personal CHI you consume.

TIER I.name: Void shield
TIER I.effect: BARRIERS you manifest have a SMALL bonus to SOAK.

TIER II.name: Void shield
TIER II.effect: BARRIERS you manifest can be used on a touched target (no effect on yourself). This count as a SUSTAINED effect.

TIER III.name: Void shield
TIER III.effect: When anything hits you while you have an active BARRIER, before damage is resolved, you can as a FREE ACTION SUPPRESS your SPIRIT to raise all DEFENSES to EXTREME against that attack.

TIER I.name: Touch of Midas
TIER I.effect: If you have any CHI you can spend 1 point of it to gain a LARGE bonus to BINDING checks. This CHI does not go into the RAW pool.

TIER II.name: Touch of Midas
TIER II.effect: You can now create RELIC SHARDS out of anything; any object will do. You no longer need XP or Credits + preparation time for those.

TIER III.name: Touch of Midas
TIER III.effect: When you use a Relic SHARDS you gain one of the following effect: Can target 1 additional target, both minor effect and intermediate effect are invoked at once or you can modify range and AOE's by +/- 100%.

TIER I.name: Spiritual Conduit
TIER I.effect: When binding a SPIRIT, you gain a SMALL bonus to all SKILLS for as long as the BINDING holds.

TIER II.name: Spiritual Conduit
TIER II.effect: While BINDING a SPIRIT your spells can supply 1 point of CHI from the bound spirit owner. You must still pay the additional cost yourself if the spell cost more than 1 CHI.

TIER III.name: Spiritual Conduit
TIER III.effect: When you successfully complete a BINDING against a SPIRIT, you recover CHI up to your maximum value.

TIER I.name: Serenity
TIER I.effect: While at maximum MORALE you have a LARGE bonus to any SKILL roll that provides a beneficial effect to an ally or yourself.

TIER II.name: Serenity
TIER II.effect: When taking MORALE damage you can decide to take the damage as HEALTH damage instead; the damage cannot be split.

TIER III.name: Serenity
TIER III.effect: As long as you are at maximum MORALE and are not suffering from any TRAUMA you gain a LARGE bonus to all DEFENSES.

TIER I.name: Pervasive Casting
TIER I.effect: You can still SUSTAIN effects while your spirit is SUPRESSED, your SPIRIT is considered PASSIVE.

TIER II.name: Pervasive Casting
TIER II.effect: You can pick one BARRIER, SPIRIT POWER or SPELL  of your choice to be still usable while your spirit is SUPRESSED (pick one when suppressing your spirit). This counts as a SUSTAINED effect for as long as your SPIRIT remains SUPRESSED.

TIER III.name: Pervasive Casting
TIER III.effect: You are near impossible to detect as a spellcaster, all your spells have the INV modifier. You can use BARRIERS, SPIRIT POWERS and SPELLS while your spirit is SUPRESSED.

TIER I.name: Resilient Barrier
TIER I.effect: While you have a BARRIER active you gain a SMALL bonus to all SPELLS parameters of the same category of that barrier.

TIER II.name: Resilient Barrier
TIER II.effect: When you BARRIER takes damage you refresh your QUICK action if it was down.

TIER III.name: Resilient Barrier
TIER III.effect: While you are defending with a BARRIER any damage you take is always STUN damage.

TIER I.name: Otherworldly rage
TIER I.effect: When your SPIRIT is not supressed and you have no active defenses (ARMOR, FORCEFIELD, DATACOM or BARRIER) you deal maximum damage on all attacks.

TIER II.name: Otherworldly rage
TIER II.effect: When dealing maximum damage from otherworldly rage you can alter the damage type to be the same as any spell known by your spirit.

TIER III.name: Otherworldly rage
TIER III.effect: When you take any damage while under the effect of otherworldly rage gain a SURGE. (max once per round).

TIER I.name: Wraith born
TIER I.effect: When spending CHI you add the spent CHI to your minimum SOAK value, this value cannot exceed your MAXIMUM SOAK.

TIER II.name: Wraith born
TIER II.effect: As long as you have used a SPELL this round you gain PHASING. If you used 3 or more CHI in that round, your phasing chance is 50%.

TIER III.name: Wraith born
TIER III.effect: If you have spent any CHI during your turn you can pass through allies, enemies and non solid obstacles as if they were not there. You do not trigger opportunity attacks when moving through enemy spaces.

TIER I.name: Martyr
TIER I.effect: You recover 1 CHI every time you are wounded.

TIER II.name: Martyr
TIER II.effect: When taking a hit that results in a TRAUMA, you can use an INSTANT REACTION to cast any SPELL you know that requires a STANDARD or QUICK action.

TIER III.name: Martyr
TIER III.effect: All numeric values of your spells gain a SMALL bonus when suffering from LIGHT TRAUMA. This bonus is LARGE when suffering from MAJOR TRAUMA.

TIER I.name: Sustained magics
TIER I.effect: You no longer lose SUSTAIN effect when DAZED, STUNNED or DYING

TIER II.name: Sustained magics
TIER II.effect: You can now sustain 2 effects at the same time.

TIER III.name: Sustained magics
TIER III.effect: You recover the CHI spent on SUSTAINED effects when they end.

TIER I.name: Spirit link
TIER I.effect: You increase the maximum SPELLs your SPIRIT can possess by one.

TIER II.name: Spirit link
TIER II.effect: Your spirit can now have any spell types, you are no longer limited to it's category limitations.

TIER III.name: Spirit link
TIER III.effect: Your spirit cannot be bound while you are not incapacitated.

TIER I.name: Necromancer
TIER I.effect: You can spend 1 point of CHI when one of your spells causes a DYING result  to instead cause a DESTROYED result.

TIER II.name: Necromancer
TIER II.effect: When a living creature enters DYING or DESTROYED within 10m of you, your spells cost no CHI until the next maintenance phase.

TIER III.name: Necromancer
TIER III.effect: The numeric values of all your spells are increased by the number of recently dead (same SCENE) creatures within 10m. Numeric bonus cannot exceed your SKILL level.

TIER I.name: Scion of old
TIER I.effect: Your CRITICAL range when using relics is improved by 1 rank. CRITICAL results on your BINDING check when using relics result in the cooldown not activating in addition to any other effects.

TIER II.name: Scion of old
TIER II.effect: Relics you use count as 1 tier higher (up to major).

TIER III.name: Scion of old
TIER III.effect: Your RELIC SHARDS can be reused (must rebind a spell in them first). You can also activate 3 RELICS per day instead of only one.

TIER I.name: Soul reaver
TIER I.effect: You can spend 1 CHI as a QUICK action to add the SPIRITBANE modifier to an attack or spell.

TIER II.name: Soul reaver
TIER II.effect: Your melee damage with natural weapons gains SPIRITBANE and the CHI damage is leeched back to you.

TIER III.name: Soul reaver
TIER III.effect: You can use MINOR SPELLS as a free action when performing MARTIAL ARTS or DEXTERITY attacks. The SPELL target must be the same as the attack target. Spells used in that way gain SPIRITBANE.

TIER I.name: Zen moment
TIER I.effect: When recovering from an AILMMENT or TRAUMA, your next SPELL that round has it's action cost reduced by 1 category (COMPLEX-REGULAR-QUICK). Cannot reduce action cost under QUICK.

TIER II.name: Zen moment
TIER II.effect: When suffering a AILMENT or TRAUMA, you can use your QUICK action to cast any spell you know as an immediate reaction.

TIER III.name: Zen moment
TIER III.effect: When recovering from an AILMMENT or TRAUMA, all of your SPELLS in the next round can be done as FREE actions regardless of their regular action cost.

TIER I.name: Spirit born
TIER I.effect: You have a SMALL bonus to any skills used when interacting with SPIRITS or people with SPIRITS.

TIER II.name: Spirit born
TIER II.effect: When using RAW CHI, the action cost is reduced by 1 category (COMPLEX -> REGULAR -> QUICK). This cannot reduce the action cost under QUICK.

TIER III.name: Spirit born
TIER III.effect: You now have 1 personal SPELL slot (in addition to the ones granted by your spirit) that's bound to you as a person. That slot can hold any spell, utility or barrier. This spell always cost a maximum of 1 CHI and can be used even while your spirit is suppressed.

TIER I.name: Meditate
TIER I.effect: While your spirit is SUPRESSED you recover one CHI every maintenance phase.

TIER II.name: Meditate
TIER II.effect: While meditating you can forego the CHI recovery to instead grant LUCKY VS all AILMENTS.

TIER III.name: Meditate
TIER III.effect: Anytime you recover CHI while meditating you also recover an equivalent amount of MORALE and HEALTH.

TIER I.name: Technomancer
TIER I.effect: When using a relic you have a 50% chance not to activate its cooldown (relics shards are not affected).

TIER II.name: Technomancer
TIER II.effect: You no longer have skill penalties from using non relic equipment. You can no longer cast MAJOR spells (Relic shards are unnafected).

TIER III.name: Technomancer
TIER III.effect: You replace your SPIRIT with a MAJOR RELIC. It counts as a PASSIVE MAJOR SPIRIT that cannot be bound. Its spells are fixed at creation (cost 1 shard per) and can never change.

TIER I.name: Avatar
TIER I.effect: Your Barrier now always count as if your SPIRIT is AWAKENED but it no longer increases when your spirit is EMPOWERED.

TIER II.name: Avatar
TIER II.effect: If your SPIRIT is ever bound against your will you gain a LARGE bonus to all ATTRIBUTES, DEFENSES and ignore the negative effects on all TRAUMAS. This effect is immediately lost when the binding ends.

TIER III.name: Avatar
TIER III.effect: If you ever suffer DYING or DESTROYED state while your spirit is NOT SUPPRESSED, your ignore the effect that caused the status and disappear from reality until the end of the SCENE.  If this prevented a DESTROYED result, your SPIRIT is destroyed as well.

TIER I.name: God bound
TIER I.effect: While not SUPPRESSED your spirit grants a SMALL bonus to the DEFENSE ATTRIBUTE that matches your spirit's primary type (ie PRIMALIST is ENDURANCE).

TIER II.name: God bound
TIER II.effect: While being infused by you SPIRIT you have maximum SOAK against damage from any attacks that target the same defense as your spirit's primary defense.

TIER III.name: God bound

skill_rules: To buy skills you must spend experience points. At character creation you can just spend this experience as you wish. New characters cannot buy skills levels over 5

Existing characters that wish to increase their skills must seek training, this can be done by either purchasing a training course, having another character with a higher level skill teach you or with game master approval, you can increase it instantly if he thinks that you spent enough time using this skill to justify the higher level.

Regardless of method, you still need to spend the experience points.
Every experience point invested in a category (PHYSICAL, MENTAL, SOCIAL, ACUITY) grants the character 1 TALENT point to buy talents (See talents).
Experience cost for SKILLS is 1 up per skill level. You must buy every level of the skill
Training skills cost 10 000cr per level and take a full day per level for training. Every skill level must be purchased separately.
If you do not have the free time required to train, you can still purchase the training and progress but your progress will be three times as long.
Skill chips (EVO Cybernetics) cost 50 000cr per skill level but do not require you purchase lower level of the skills. Availability is equal to the skill level.
Example: Increasing a skill from 3 to 6 would cost a total of 15 XP and 150 000 credits. It would also take 15 days of training (or 45 if you do not take time off).
